Chroniclers described a brief clash with its inhabitants and noticed a change in the style of their houses. From Capachequi the expedition continued toward the chiefdom of Toa.
simp_chinese: 卡帕切基是佐治亚西南部河流地区的一个原住民领地。1540年3月，埃尔南多·德索托的军队离开阿巴拉契人的冬营地后来到这里。西班牙人建造驳船，渡过一条涨水的河流，进入该地区；这条河很可能是弗林特河。编年史记载，他们与当地居民短暂交战，并注意到房屋样式发生了变化。远征队随后离开卡帕切基，继续前往托阿酋邦。

english: The Capalulu Strait is a narrow passage between Taliabu and Mangole in the Sula Islands. Strong tidal currents race through the channel, making this waterway a demanding one for sailors. The islands' mountainous and wooded shores face each other across the strait, which cuts through the chain north of the Seram Sea.
simp_chinese: 卡帕卢卢海峡是苏拉群岛中塔利阿布岛与曼戈莱岛之间的狭窄水道。强劲潮流奔涌其间，给航行带来挑战。两岛多山而林木茂密的海岸隔峡相望，水道穿过塞兰海以北的岛链。

english: The country around Capão Bonito lies among the wooded hills and streams of the upper Paranapanema basin. In the eighteenth century gold was sought along the São José River, drawing prospectors to the region. A settlement grew near the workings and was later known as Freguesia Velha. Its history belongs to the expansion of mining into the forested interior of southern São Paulo.
simp_chinese: 卡庞博尼图周围的土地位于帕拉纳帕内马河上游流域，林木覆盖的丘陵与溪流交错。十八世纪，人们沿圣若泽河寻找黄金，吸引探矿者来到这一地区。矿区附近逐渐形成聚落，后来称为旧堂区。它的历史与采矿业向圣保罗南部森林内陆扩张相联系。

english: The Caparo River descends from the Venezuelan Andean foothills into the western Llanos, joining waters that flow toward the Apure and Orinoco. Forests and savannas meet in this lowland region, where wet and dry seasons bring marked changes to the rivers. The Apure basin gathers many streams from the Cordillera de Mérida, carrying their waters across the broad plains toward the Orinoco.
simp_chinese: 卡帕罗河从委内瑞拉安第斯山麓流入西部亚诺斯，汇入流向阿普雷河与奥里诺科河的水系。森林与稀树草原在此相接，湿季和旱季使河流水量显著变化。阿普雷河流域汇集来自梅里达山脉的众多溪流，将水带过宽阔平原，流向奥里诺科河。

english: Capatárida lies near the coast west of Coro, in the dry country of northwestern Venezuela. It was inhabited by Caquetío communities whose lands and local leaders remained important under Spanish rule. In the seventeenth century Caquetío people contested encroachments on their lands, and colonial records also describe their chiefs helping to watch the coast against contraband. The settlement forms part of a region of dry plains and intermittent rivers.
simp_chinese: 卡帕塔里达位于科罗以西海岸附近，地处委内瑞拉西北部干旱地区。这里曾有卡克蒂奥社群居住，其土地与地方首领在西班牙统治下仍然重要。十七世纪，卡克蒂奥人反对侵占土地；殖民记载也提到他们的首领协助监视海岸，防范走私。聚落所属地区由干燥平原和间歇性河流构成。

english: Cape Ad-Dariah lies in the waters off the Cilician coast, near the western approach to the Gulf of Alexandretta. The gulf forms the easternmost inlet of the Mediterranean, with the Nur Mountains rising along its eastern side. To the west, rivers descending from the Taurus carry their waters across the fertile Cilician plain. The coast belongs to a region long divided between the mountainous country of Rough Cilicia and the broad lowlands of the east.
simp_chinese: 达里亚角位于奇里乞亚海岸外的水域，靠近亚历山大勒塔湾的西侧入口。这座海湾是地中海最东端的海湾，努尔山脉沿其东岸耸立。西面，从托罗斯山脉流下的河流穿过肥沃的奇里乞亚平原，注入大海。这片海岸所属的地区，历来分为多山的崎岖奇里乞亚和东部广阔的低地。

english: Between the Sula Islands and Buru, the waters of the Seram Sea extend through the island world of Maluku. Mangole and Sanana lie to the north, while mountainous Buru rises to the south. Narrow channels divide the Sula Islands, including the Capalulu Strait between Taliabu and Mangole, where strong currents flow between their shores.
simp_chinese: 苏拉群岛与布鲁岛之间，塞兰海穿过马鲁古的群岛地带。曼戈莱和萨纳纳位于北方，多山的布鲁岛耸立在南方。狭窄水道分隔苏拉群岛，其中塔利阿布与曼戈莱之间的卡帕卢卢海峡有强劲海流。

english: Cape al-Hikmah projects into the Mediterranean from Egypt’s northwestern shore. On its eastern side lay Phoenicus, a harbour used in Greek and Roman times. Remains along the shore and beneath the water mark the old anchorage, one of a series of ports on the route along the North African coast.
simp_chinese: 希克马角从埃及西北海岸伸入地中海。海角东侧曾有腓尼基库斯港，在希腊和罗马时代供船只停泊。岸边和水下遗存标示着这处古老锚地；它是北非沿岸航路上的一系列港口之一。

sources.title: 388625780 Title GEO-ARCHEOLOGY OF PHOENICUS GREEK AND ROMAN HARBOUR IN RAS EL- HEKMA NW COAST OF EGYPT

english: The waters off Cape Al-Hilal face the northern shore of Cyrenaica, where the limestone heights of the Green Mountain project towards the Mediterranean. Along this coast stood Apollonia, the harbour of Cyrene, sheltered in part by an offshore ridge of islands. Cyrene itself lay inland on the plateau above. The sea beyond the headland opens north towards Crete, across the water known to ancient geographers as the Libyan Sea.
simp_chinese: 希拉勒角外海面对昔兰尼加北岸，绿山的石灰岩高地在此伸向地中海。古城阿波罗尼亚坐落于这一海岸，是昔兰尼的港口，离岸岛屿组成的山脊为其提供部分庇护。昔兰尼城本身则位于内陆高原上。岬角外的海面向北通往克里特，古代地理学家称这片水域为利比亚海。

sources.title: Enas Bubtana ,Continuity and Change in Early Islamic in Cyrenaica.pdf

english: The Natuna Islands rise from the southern South China Sea between Borneo and the Malay Peninsula. Great Natuna and its neighbours form a group of islands and reefs surrounded by open water, with the Subi Islands farther south. Headlands mark their shores, while channels link the scattered islands across the sea.
simp_chinese: 纳土纳群岛从婆罗洲与马来半岛之间的南海南部水域升起。大纳土纳及邻岛组成散布于开阔海面的岛礁群，苏比群岛位于更南方。岬角标记岛屿海岸，水道将海上分散的岛屿相连。

english: Cape Apostolos Andreas forms the northeastern tip of Cyprus, at the end of the long Karpas peninsula. Its rocky headland reaches toward the open eastern Mediterranean, a landmark for ships passing between the island and the Levant. Near the cape stands a monastery dedicated to Saint Andrew, with a medieval chapel among its buildings. The exposed coast gives way to beaches and hills farther along the peninsula.
simp_chinese: 圣安德烈角位于塞浦路斯东北端，坐落在狭长卡尔帕斯半岛的尽头。岩石岬地伸向开阔的东地中海，是船只往来岛屿与黎凡特的地标。海角附近有献给圣安德烈的修道院，院内包括一座中世纪小教堂。沿半岛向内，暴露海岸逐渐转为沙滩与丘陵。

english: Cape Arnauti projects from the Akamas peninsula at the northwestern corner of Cyprus. Rocky shores, cliffs and small bays meet the Mediterranean below a landscape of scrub and hills. Green and loggerhead turtles nest on sandy beaches along this coast. For ships following Cyprus's western shore, the headland marks the turn toward the island's northern coast.
simp_chinese: 阿尔纳乌蒂角从塞浦路斯西北端的阿卡马斯半岛伸出。岩岸、峭壁和小湾在灌丛与丘陵下方濒临地中海，绿海龟和红海龟来到沿岸沙滩产卵。对沿塞浦路斯西岸航行的船只而言，岬角标示转向岛屿北岸的方向。

english: Cape Baba projects into the Black Sea near Ereğli on the western Anatolian coast. This rocky headland lies west of Amasra, along a shore where hills descend toward small bays and harbours. Sailors following the coast between the Bosporus and the ports of Paphlagonia passed a succession of prominent capes, using them to recognise their position along the sea's southern edge.
simp_chinese: 巴巴角位于安纳托利亚西部黑海海岸的埃雷利附近，岩石岬角伸入海中。它在阿马斯拉以西，沿岸丘陵向小海湾与港口下降。船只沿海往来于博斯普鲁斯和帕夫拉戈尼亚港口时，会经过一系列醒目岬角，借此辨认黑海南岸的航程。

english: Cape Bangsi lies on the eastern coast of Sumatra beside the Strait of Malacca. A local tale tells of King Sulung, who cast away his flute here during a sorrowful journey; the headland took its name from the instrument. The cape faces a waterway long travelled by merchants sailing between the Indian Ocean and the ports of Southeast Asia.
simp_chinese: 邦西角位于苏门答腊东岸，濒临马六甲海峡。当地传说讲述苏隆王在一段悲伤的旅途中，将笛子抛在这里，岬角因此得名。岬角面向一条古老的水道，商人长期沿此往来于印度洋和东南亚港口之间。

sources.title: the establisment of islamic rule in eastern coast of sumatra.pdf

english: The Baram River reaches the South China Sea on the northwestern coast of Borneo. Flowing through tropical forest, it spreads into a delta at its mouth, where river-borne sediment meets the tides and waves. The coast around the river forms part of the long Sarawak shore, between the island's forested interior and the open sea.
simp_chinese: 巴拉姆河在婆罗洲西北岸汇入南海。河流穿过热带森林，在入海处展开为三角洲，携来的泥沙与潮汐、波浪相遇。河口附近海岸属于砂拉越漫长的沿岸地带，位于岛上森林腹地与开阔海洋之间。

english: The western coast of Borneo faces the Karimata Strait, with low river mouths and headlands along the shore. Offshore islands stand between Borneo and Belitung, while the strait links the South China Sea with the Java Sea. Rivers from the island's forested interior reach the coast through estuaries and wetlands.
simp_chinese: 婆罗洲西岸面向卡里马塔海峡，沿岸分布着低平河口和岬角。近海岛屿位于婆罗洲与勿里洞岛之间，海峡连接南海和爪哇海。来自岛上森林腹地的河流穿过河口与湿地，抵达海岸。

english: Cape Beata marks the southernmost point of Hispaniola, projecting into the Caribbean Sea. Beata Island lies a short distance southwest of the cape, across a channel of coastal water. Columbus stopped at the island during his fourth voyage, waiting for favourable winds before continuing along the coast. The cape and nearby island form prominent landmarks on the approach to the southwestern shore of Hispaniola.
simp_chinese: 贝阿塔角是伊斯帕尼奥拉最南端的海角，向加勒比海突出。贝阿塔岛位于海角西南方不远处，两者之间隔着沿岸水道。哥伦布在第四次航行期间曾停留岛上，等待顺风再沿海岸继续航行。海角和邻近岛屿是接近伊斯帕尼奥拉西南岸时显著的地标。

english: Cape Beddouza projects into the Atlantic north of Safi, on a Moroccan coast of cliffs, beaches and rocky headlands. Also known as Cape Cantin, it separates stretches of shoreline travelled by seabirds as well as by ships. The southward-flowing Canary Current and the prevailing northeasterly winds shape the waters off this coast, bringing cooler water towards the surface. Beyond the cape lies Safi, a port whose maritime connections extended across the Atlantic and Mediterranean.
simp_chinese: 贝杜扎角伸入萨菲以北的大西洋，周围是摩洛哥海岸的峭壁、海滩和岩石岬角。它也称坎廷角，海鸟与船只都会沿着这段海岸经过。南流的加那利洋流和盛行东北风塑造了近海水域，使较冷的海水上升。海角以南是萨菲港，那里曾通过海路与大西洋和地中海各地相连。

sources.title: rapport eies projet de dessalement safi.pdf

english: In the Makassar Strait, the waters off western Sulawesi lie west of the Lariang River mouth and north of Mamuju. The Lariang gathers the Koro and Pebatua rivers in the island's interior before reaching the strait. Across the channel, Borneo forms the opposite shore.
simp_chinese: 望加锡海峡中，这片苏拉威西西岸外海位于拉里昂河口以西、马穆朱以北。拉里昂河在岛屿内陆汇集科罗河与珀巴图阿河，随后注入海峡。隔着水道，对岸是婆罗洲。

english: Cape Ben Sakka is a rocky point on the northern coast of Tunisia, near Bizerte. It marks the northernmost reach of the African mainland, where the shore faces the central Mediterranean. To the east lies the Strait of Sicily, the passage between Tunisia and Sicily that joins the western and eastern basins of the sea. Surface waters flow east through the strait while deeper waters move in the opposite direction.
simp_chinese: 本赛卡角是突尼斯北岸的一处岩石岬角，位于比塞大附近。这里是非洲大陆向北伸出的极点，海岸面向地中海中部。东面是突尼斯与西西里之间的西西里海峡，连接地中海东西两大海盆。海峡的表层海水向东流动，深层海水则向西流去。

english: The northern coast of Java faces the shallow Java Sea, with lowlands and river mouths below the island's volcanic mountains. Headlands and bays break the shoreline along a coast that links the ports of western and eastern Java. Across the sea to the north lies the long southern coast of Borneo.
simp_chinese: 爪哇北岸面向浅浅的爪哇海，低地与河口位于岛屿火山山脉之下。岬角和海湾分割着海岸线，沿岸连接爪哇东西部的港口。隔海向北是婆罗洲漫长的南岸。

english: Cape Blanc extends into the Atlantic at the end of a long, narrow peninsula on the western edge of the Sahara. Its eastern shore encloses the Bay of Lévrier, while the shallow waters of the Banc d’Arguin spread to the south. Sandbanks and shifting currents complicate passage near the coast, but the surrounding waters are rich in fish. Portuguese sailors reached this coast in the fifteenth century as their voyages continued south beyond Cape Bojador.
simp_chinese: 布朗角位于一条狭长半岛的尽头，向大西洋伸出，背后是撒哈拉西缘。半岛东岸围成莱夫里耶湾，南面则延伸着阿尔金浅滩。沙洲与变化的洋流使近岸航行复杂，周围海域却盛产鱼类。十五世纪，葡萄牙航海者越过博哈多尔角继续南行，抵达了这段海岸。

english: Cape Bojador projects from the Saharan coast into the Atlantic, where shallow water and the outward sweep of the shore made a dangerous obstacle for sailors. In 1434 the Portuguese navigator Gil Eanes rounded the cape by sailing well away from land, avoiding its worst hazards. His voyage opened the way for further Portuguese expeditions along the African coast. The headland became a landmark in the gradual extension of Atlantic navigation southward.
simp_chinese: 博哈多尔角从撒哈拉海岸伸入大西洋。浅水和向外突出的海岸使它成为航海者面临的危险障碍。1434年，葡萄牙航海者吉尔·埃阿内斯远离陆地航行，避开最险恶的水域，绕过了海角。他的航行使葡萄牙人得以继续沿非洲海岸探航，博哈多尔角也成为大西洋航路逐渐向南扩展的地标。

english: Cape Bojeador marks the northwestern tip of Luzon, where the coast turns from the South China Sea towards the waters north of the Philippines. The headland is a landmark for vessels approaching Luzon from the north. Beyond it, ships rounding the island can continue towards the Babuyan Channel and the Pacific side of the archipelago.
simp_chinese: 博赫阿多尔角位于吕宋岛西北端，海岸在此从南海转向菲律宾北方的水域。这处岬角是从北方驶近吕宋的船只所见的地标。绕过岛屿后，船只可以继续前往巴布延海峡及群岛面向太平洋的一侧。

english: Cape Bolinao forms the western edge of Lingayen Gulf on Luzon's northwestern coast. The headland faces the South China Sea, while Santiago Island and the Caquiputan Strait lie on its eastern side. Extensive coral reefs surround the cape and its neighbouring waters, at the entrance to a gulf fed by the Agno River.
simp_chinese: 博利瑙角位于吕宋西北岸，构成仁牙因湾西侧边缘。岬角面向南海，东侧有圣地亚哥岛和卡基普坦海峡。广阔珊瑚礁环绕岬角与邻近水域；阿格诺河流入岬角附近的海湾。

english: Cape Bon projects from northeastern Tunisia into the central Mediterranean. The peninsula separates the Gulf of Tunis to the north from the Gulf of Hammamet to the south, its hills and valleys enclosed by the sea on three sides. Seasonal rivers cross its hills and run down to the shores on either side. Its northern tip was known in antiquity as the Cape of Mercury. On the eastern shore stand the remains of Kerkouane, a Punic town whose ruins preserve traces of the settlements that once faced these waters.
simp_chinese: 邦角从突尼斯东北部伸入地中海中部。半岛将北面的突尼斯湾与南面的哈马马特湾分开，山丘和河谷三面环海。季节性河流穿过山丘，流向两侧的海岸。半岛北端在古代被称为墨丘利角；东岸则有布匿城镇克尔库阿内的遗址，保存着昔日面向这片海域的聚落痕迹。

english: Cape Bonemanjing faces the Makassar Strait off western Sulawesi. To the east the Lariang River flows out of the island's mountains, fed by the Koro and Pebatua. The channel between Sulawesi and Borneo joins the Celebes Sea in the north to the Java Sea in the south.
simp_chinese: 博内曼京角面向苏拉威西西岸外的望加锡海峡。东面的拉里昂河由科罗河与珀巴图阿河汇成，从岛屿山地流出。苏拉威西与婆罗洲之间的水道连接北方苏拉威西海与南方爪哇海。

english: The western coast of Luzon around Botolan faces the South China Sea beneath the Zambales Mountains. Rivers descend from these heights to the coastal plain, while the shoreline is broken by bays and headlands. To the south the range continues towards the Bataan Peninsula and the entrance to Manila Bay.
simp_chinese: 吕宋岛博托兰一带的西岸面向南海，后方是三描礼士山脉。河流从山地流向沿海平原，海岸则由海湾和岬角分割。山脉向南延伸至巴丹半岛及马尼拉湾入口附近。

english:
The cape lies at the southern end of Palawan, near the passage between the Sulu Sea and the South China Sea. The main island stretches between Mindoro and Borneo, and its western coast forms a chain of sheltered coves, reef flats and headlands. Cape Buliluyan marks a notable turn in that coast and lies close to Balabac and the northern approach to Borneo.

Palawan preserves occupation going back more than 50,000 years, including remains from Tabon Caves. From about two thousand years BCE to 1000 CE, it participated in the Maritime Jade Road, connecting island Southeast Asia in a long-distance trade network. Its coasts also sheltered Palaweño, Tagbanwa, Palaw'an and Molbog communities with distinct links to interior forests and neighboring seaways.

Chinese records described Sandao in the thirteenth century as a polity under Ma-i, and later maritime trade brought Palawan into contact with Brunei, Sulu and the Spanish Philippines. For sailors, the cape was a landmark where the protected waters along Palawan gave way to the open Sulu Sea; for residents, it joined fishing grounds, forest products and routes toward Borneo. By the late eighteenth century, British navigators charted the cape together with Balabac as part of the approaches to the Sulu Sea.
simp_chinese:
布利卢颜角位于巴拉望岛南端，靠近苏禄海与南海之间的通道。巴拉望主岛从民都洛方向延伸至婆罗洲，西岸由避风小湾、礁坪和岬角串联；布利卢颜角标志岸线的一处显著转折，距巴拉克巴克岛和婆罗洲北侧航路不远。

塔邦洞窟等遗址显示，巴拉望的人类活动延续五万多年。约从公元前2000年至公元1000年，这里参与海上玉路，把东南亚岛屿纳入长期远距离贸易网络。海岸还分布着巴拉望人、塔格班瓦人、帕拉万人和莫尔博格人等社群，他们同内陆森林和邻近海域保持各自联系。

十三世纪的中国文献把桑多记为麻逸属下的政体，后来海上贸易又把巴拉望同文莱、苏禄及西班牙治下的菲律宾联系起来。对航海者而言，布利卢颜角是从巴拉望沿岸受保护水域进入开阔苏禄海的地标；对居民而言，这里连接渔场、林产品和通往婆罗洲的路线。十八世纪后期，英国航海者已把该角与巴拉克巴克一并绘入通往苏禄海的航图。

english: Along the southern side of the Gulf of Aden, the Somali coast is backed by dry mountains and cut by riverbeds that carry water only after rain. Headlands and rocky slopes face the sea, where seasonal winds influence navigation. The gulf connects this shore with Arabia to the north and the Indian Ocean to the east, providing a route for sailors and traders moving around the Horn of Africa.
simp_chinese: 亚丁湾南侧的索马里海岸背靠干燥山地，河床只有降雨之后才有水流。岬角与岩坡面向大海，季节风影响海上航行。海湾将这片海岸与北方阿拉伯及东方印度洋连接起来，为绕行非洲之角的水手和商人提供航路，也让沿岸聚落能够与对岸的港口保持联系。

english:
Cape Calavite opens toward the maritime approaches to Luzon and Manila Bay. Its northern shore belongs to Pampanga, whose name recalls the pampang, or riverbanks, along which communities developed. Rivers cross fertile lowlands and reach the sea through broad estuaries, linking farmers, fishers and craftspeople with coastal shipping.

When Spain organized Pampanga in 1571, it became the first Spanish province on Luzon. Its original jurisdiction stretched across much of Central Luzon, and its rice, fish, timber and skilled labor supplied Manila. Boats and river roads joined inland towns to coastal anchorages, while Chinese, Malay and Spanish traders exchanged cloth, metal, food and forest goods.

Cape Calavite’s waters therefore reached into a river-built province rather than a single port. Tidal flats, muddy estuaries and monsoon winds shaped fishing and coastal movement. Towns grew at crossings and landing places where produce could be gathered, stored and carried toward the capital. The cape’s identity belongs to this network of river valleys and sheltered sea approaches. Riverboats carried rice and salt to coastal markets. Estuaries supplied fish and mangrove wood.
simp_chinese:
卡拉维特角面向吕宋和馬尼拉湾的海上入口。其北岸属于邦板牙，地名让人想起社群沿河岸发展的历史。河流穿过肥沃低地，经宽阔河口入海，把农民、渔民和工匠同沿海航运连接起来。

1571年西班牙设置邦板牙省时，它成为吕宋首个西班牙行省。最初辖区覆盖中吕宋大部分，稻米、鱼、木材和熟练劳力供应马尼拉。船只与河道把内陆城镇同沿海泊地相连，中国、马来和西班牙商人交换布匹、金属、食物与林产品。

卡拉维特角水域因而通向一个由河流塑造的省份，而非单一港口。潮滩、泥质河口和季风影响捕鱼与沿岸航行。城镇在渡口和登陆点成长，农产品在此汇集、储存并运往首都。海角身份属于这一河谷与避风海路组成的网络。河船把稻米和盐运往沿海市场。河口供应鱼类与红树林木材，季风决定小船出海时机。

english:
The Canaveral coast projects into the Atlantic from central Florida, with the Cape forming a conspicuous mark between the Banana River lagoon and the Gulf Stream beyond. Offshore shoals and swift currents made the point hazardous for sailing ships. Behind the barrier, Indian River and Mosquito Lagoon offered calmer water, mangrove-rimmed creeks and routes through a chain of estuaries.

During the first Spanish period, the Indian River shore belonged to the Ais, while the Surruque held country around Mosquito Lagoon. Both peoples fished, gathered shellfish and used the productive lagoon edge. Spanish explorers gave the cape the name Cabo Cañaveral in the early sixteenth century; cañaveral referred to reeds or a canefield. The point became a known landfall for shipwreck survivors. French survivors from the Trinité built a fort from the wreck in 1565, and Spanish officials later negotiated with the Ais for the return of castaways.

English privateers and Spanish missions brought contact, disease and imperial rivalry to the coast. Florida passed between Spain and Britain before returning to Spanish rule in 1783 and joining the United States in 1821. The cape remained a dangerous but useful landmark as the plantation and territorial frontier moved south. Its launch sites and port belong to later centuries.
simp_chinese:
卡纳维拉尔海岸从佛罗里达中部伸入大西洋，海角在香蕉河潟湖与外海之间构成醒目的低矮地标。近岸浅滩与湍急洋流对帆船极为危险。屏障岛背后，印第安河与蚊子潟湖提供较平静的水面、红树林环绕的溪口，以及贯穿河口湖链的通道。

西班牙首次统治时期，印第安河岸由艾斯人居住，蚊子潟湖周边属于苏鲁克人。两族都捕捞鱼贝，并利用物产丰富的潟湖边缘。十六世纪初，西班牙探险者把海角命名为“卡尼亚韦拉尔”，此词指芦苇地或甘蔗田。海角由此成为沉船幸存者的登陆点。1565年，法国“三一”号幸存者用船材筑堡；西班牙官员后来与艾斯人协商归还遇难者。

英国私掠者、传教士及殖民机构的到来，为海岸带来更多接触、疾病和帝国竞争。佛罗里达曾在西班牙与英国之间易手，1783年重归西班牙，1821年加入美国。随着种植园和领地边疆南移，海角始终是危险而有用的航标。其后的发射场与深水港不属于本篇所述的近代早期。

english: Cape Canding projects from the northeastern coast of Java near the waters separating the island from Bali. It is also known as Tanjung Candibang. Beyond the headland the coast curves towards the Bali Strait, a narrow passage between the two islands; to the north lie the waters of the Bali Sea.
simp_chinese: 坎丁角从爪哇东北岸伸出，靠近分隔爪哇与巴厘岛的水域，也称钱迪邦角。岬角之外，海岸弯向两岛之间狭窄的巴厘海峡；北面则是巴厘海。

english: Cape Caphereus projects from the southeastern tip of Euboea toward Andros, forming the narrow Kafireas Strait. Also known as the Doro Passage, it long had a reputation as one of the Aegean's most dangerous waters for shipping. In 1827 Greek pirates captured the British merchant ship #italic Comet#! there, only for the American warship #italic Porpoise#! to recover it. The British sailing ship #italic Providence#! was lost in the channel in 1835.
simp_chinese: 卡菲雷乌斯角从埃维亚岛东南端伸向安德罗斯岛，形成狭窄的卡菲雷乌斯海峡。这条水道又称多罗海峡，长期以来以爱琴海最危险的通航水域之一闻名。1827年，希腊海盗在此俘获英国商船“彗星”号，美国军舰“海豚”号随后夺回了商船。1835年，英国帆船“天意”号在海峡失事。

english: The waters off Cherchell wash the Algerian coast west of Algiers. Here the ancient city of Caesarea once served as a royal capital and a Roman port. After a long decline, the town's maritime life revived in the early sixteenth century with the arrival of Andalusians expelled from Spain and the forces of the Barbarossa brothers. Cherchell remained a smaller harbour than Algiers or Ténès, but Christian ships visited it and a Christian consul resided there.
simp_chinese: 舍尔沙勒外海濒临阿尔及尔以西的阿尔及利亚海岸。古代的凯撒里亚城曾在此充当王国首都和罗马港口。经历漫长衰落后，十六世纪初，被逐出西班牙的安达卢西亚人与巴巴罗萨兄弟的势力来到此地，城镇的海上生活随之复苏。舍尔沙勒港规模不及阿尔及尔或泰内斯，但仍有基督徒船只来访，也有基督徒领事驻扎。

english: Cape Cod Bay lies within the curve of Cape Cod, enclosed by the peninsula to the east and south and open northward toward Massachusetts Bay. In 1620 the Mayflower found shelter at the tip of the cape, where its passengers drew up the agreement known as the Mayflower Compact. They then crossed the bay and established Plymouth on its western shore, in a country long inhabited by Wampanoag communities.
simp_chinese: 科德角湾位于科德角弯曲的半岛内侧，东面和南面受半岛环抱，北面通向马萨诸塞湾。1620年，五月花号在海角尖端避风，船上的乘客在那里订立了后来称为五月花号公约的协议。此后他们横渡海湾，在西岸建立普利茅斯聚落；这片土地长期以来已有万帕诺亚格社群居住。

english: Cape Corrientes projects from the southern side of the Guanahacabibes Peninsula at Cuba’s western end. The low limestone peninsula lies between the Caribbean Sea and the Gulf of Mexico, with the Yucatán Channel to the west. Ships rounding the coast pass between Cuba and the Yucatán peninsula, where warm Caribbean water enters the Gulf. Bays, reefs and a low shoreline mark the approaches to the cape.
simp_chinese: 科连特斯角伸出于古巴最西端瓜纳阿卡维韦斯半岛的南侧。这片低平的石灰岩半岛位于加勒比海与墨西哥湾之间，西面是尤卡坦海峡。绕行海岸的船只经过古巴与尤卡坦半岛之间的水域，温暖的加勒比海水也从这里流入墨西哥湾。海湾、礁石与低岸构成海角附近的景观。

english: The northwestern coast of Luzon faces the South China Sea, with mountains rising behind a narrow strip of coastal land. At the island's northern end, Cape Bojeador marks the turn towards the waters north of the Philippines. Ships following the coast could round the headland and continue towards the island passages leading east.
simp_chinese: 吕宋西北岸面向南海，狭窄的沿海地带后方山峦耸立。岛屿北端的博赫阿多尔角标志着海岸转向菲律宾北方水域。沿岸航行的船只可以绕过岬角，继续驶向通往东方的岛间水道。

english: At the northwestern end of Sumatra, the coast of Aceh faces the Indian Ocean and the approach to the Strait of Malacca. Headlands and bays break the shoreline around the island's northern tip. This coast stood beside routes connecting South and East Asia; Lamri was among its early trading settlements, before the rise of Aceh as a major power in the region.
simp_chinese: 苏门答腊西北端的亚齐海岸面向印度洋与马六甲海峡入口，岛屿北端附近海岸岬角和海湾交错。连接南亚与东亚的航路经过这一带；在亚齐兴起成为地区强国之前，兰里已是北岸的贸易聚落之一。

sources.title: the establisment of islamic rule in eastern coast of sumatra.pdf

english:
Cape Debundsha faces the Bight of Biafra at its eastern side, where the Gulf of Guinea coastline turns eastward beyond the Niger delta. Rivers including the Cross, Wouri, Sanaga and Mungo discharge into the bight, creating mangrove creeks, shifting bars and narrow passages. The Cape area lies near Cameroon’s volcanic coast, where forested slopes descend to a humid equatorial shoreline.

Duala and neighboring coastal communities used canoes to fish, trade and move between river mouths. Forest products, salt, food and metal goods passed through markets where inland and coastal networks met. European ships entered the same waters from the fifteenth century onward, exchanging cloth and metal for ivory, pepper, slaves and local commodities. Riverine middlemen controlled access to interior suppliers and shaped the terms of trade.

By the eighteenth century the bight had become a major export zone within the Atlantic slave trade, while fishing and canoe commerce continued alongside it. Navigation depended on tide, wind and knowledge of shifting sandbars. Cape Debundsha’s identity therefore grew from an equatorial river coast where productive mangroves, canoe routes and coercive Atlantic commerce converged. Mangrove waterways served as sheltered roads. Coastal traders moved salt and food by canoe.
simp_chinese:
德本沙角面向比亚法拉湾东侧，几内亚湾海岸在尼日尔三角洲以外向东转折。克罗斯河、武里河、萨纳加河和蒙戈河等在此入海，形成红树林河汊、移动沙洲和狭窄水道。海角附近是喀麦隆火山海岸，林木山坡下降到湿润赤道岸线。

杜阿拉及邻近沿海社群以独木舟捕鱼、贸易并在河口间移动。林产品、盐、食物和金属制品在市场流通，内陆与沿海网络在此相接。十五世纪后欧洲船只进入同一水域，以布匹和金属交换象牙、胡椒、奴隶及地方货物。河运中间商控制通往内陆供应者的道路，也左右交易条件。

到十八世纪，比亚法拉湾已成为大西洋奴隶贸易的重要输出区，捕鱼和独木舟贸易仍同时进行。航行依赖潮汐、风向与对移动沙洲的认识。德本沙角的身份因而来自赤道河口海岸，生产性红树林、独木舟路线和强制性的海洋贸易在此交汇。红树林水道成为天然避风道路。沿岸商贩以独木舟运输盐和食物。

english: Cape Draa marks a bend in the Atlantic coast near the mouth of the Draa, the long river that crosses southern Morocco towards the ocean. Beyond it the coastline trends southwest towards Cape Juby and the Canary Islands. The Canary Current follows the African shore southward, while northerly winds and ocean swell can make the exposed coast difficult for sailing vessels. The river itself often fails to reach the sea except after exceptional rainfall.
simp_chinese: 德拉角位于大西洋海岸的转折处，靠近横穿摩洛哥南部、流向海洋的德拉河河口。海岸从这里向西南延伸，通向朱比角和加那利群岛。加那利洋流沿非洲海岸南流，北风与大洋涌浪使暴露的海岸对帆船构成挑战。德拉河通常只有在异常充沛的降雨之后才会流入大海。

english: Near the eastern tip of the Horn of Africa, dry mountains and steep cliffs descend toward the Gulf of Aden. Headlands mark the approach to Cape Guardafui, where the coast turns south toward the Indian Ocean. Seasonal winds can be strong, and ships rounding the horn must navigate exposed waters between the Somali shore and Socotra. The sea connects this coast with Arabia and the Red Sea.
simp_chinese: 非洲之角东端附近，干燥山地与陡峭峭壁向亚丁湾下降。一连串岬地标示通往瓜达富伊角的路线，海岸在此转向南方，面临印度洋。季节风可能十分强劲，绕过非洲之角的船只须穿越索马里海岸与索科特拉之间暴露的水域。大海将这里与阿拉伯及红海相连。

english: Cape Fener lies on the southeastern Black Sea coast near Trebizond. The headland marks a shore where the Pontic Mountains rise close behind the sea and valleys open toward inland passes. Trebizond's harbour served traders arriving from the Iranian plateau as well as ships sailing along the coast. Its position linked the eastern Black Sea with the caravan roads across Anatolia.
simp_chinese: 费内尔角位于黑海东南岸特拉布宗附近。本都山脉紧邻大海耸立，河谷则向内陆山口展开，海角标示着这段海岸。特拉布宗港既接待来自伊朗高原的商旅，也接待沿岸船只，其位置将黑海东部与穿越安纳托利亚的商队道路相连。

english: Cape Fiolent rises in steep cliffs on the southwestern coast of Crimea, near the ancient city of Chersonese. Offshore rocks and the high headland mark the approach to the Heraclean Peninsula. A monastery dedicated to Saint George stands above the shore; tradition tells of Greek sailors saved from a storm after the saint appeared to them in 891. The cliffs have long been a landmark for vessels passing the peninsula.
simp_chinese: 菲奥连特角位于克里米亚西南岸、古城赫尔松尼苏斯附近，陡峭悬崖临海而立。高耸岬角与离岸礁石标示着通往赫拉克勒亚半岛的入口。岸上有圣乔治修道院；传说891年希腊水手遭遇风暴，圣人显现并拯救了他们。悬崖长期是船只经过半岛时的醒目地标。

english: Northern Sulawesi extends eastwards as a long mountainous peninsula between the Celebes Sea and the Gulf of Tomini. Its coasts are marked by bays and headlands, while volcanic mountains rise behind them. At the eastern end, island passages lead towards the Maluku Sea and the chain of islands stretching north towards Mindanao.
simp_chinese: 苏拉威西北部是一条向东延伸的狭长多山半岛，位于苏拉威西海与托米尼湾之间。沿岸海湾与岬角交错，后方火山山峦耸立。半岛东端的岛间水道通向马鲁古海，以及向北延伸至棉兰老岛的岛链。

english: Off eastern Sumatra, islands and channels lie between the mainland and the southern South China Sea. The Riau archipelago extends across these waters, forming passages towards the Strait of Malacca and the seas east of Sumatra. Coastal headlands and island shores mark routes used by seafarers travelling among the islands.
simp_chinese: 苏门答腊东岸外，岛屿和水道分布在大陆与南海南部之间。廖内群岛横跨这片水域，形成通往马六甲海峡及苏门答腊东部诸海的通道。沿岸岬角与岛屿海岸标记着水手往来群岛的航路。

english: The western Red Sea coast lies beneath dry hills and desert roads leading toward the Nile. The medieval port of Aydhab connected those roads with ships from Arabia and the Indian Ocean. Pilgrims travelling toward Mecca also crossed from the African shore, while merchants carried goods between sea and inland markets. Reefs and islands complicated navigation along the coast.
simp_chinese: 红海西岸位于干燥丘陵之下，沙漠道路通往尼罗河。中世纪的艾扎卜港将这些道路与来自阿拉伯和印度洋的船只相连。前往麦加的朝圣者也从非洲海岸渡海，商人则在海上和内陆市场之间运输货物。沿岸礁石与岛屿使航行更为复杂。

english: Cape Hadid is a low headland on the Atlantic coast north of Essaouira. A reef extends westward from the shore, making the waters close to the cape hazardous to shipping. To the south, dunes and the islands off Essaouira shape a coast exposed to Atlantic winds and swell. These waters lie in the path of the Canary Current, which flows south along northwestern Africa and is associated with the rise of cool water near the coast.
simp_chinese: 哈迪德角是索维拉以北大西洋岸边的一处低矮岬角。礁石从海岸向西延伸，使靠近海角的航行颇具风险。南面的沙丘和索维拉外海岛屿构成一段迎受大西洋风浪的海岸。加那利洋流沿非洲西北岸向南流经这些水域，也与近岸冷水上涌有关。

english: Cape Hafun projects far into the Indian Ocean from northeastern Somalia, joined to the mainland by a narrow sandy spit. The rocky peninsula has long been a landmark on the route around the Horn of Africa. Archaeological finds of imported pottery support its identification with ancient Opone, a trading place known to sailors of the western Indian Ocean. Offshore, the Somali Current changes direction with the monsoon winds.
simp_chinese: 哈丰角从索马里东北部远远伸入印度洋，一条狭窄沙洲将岩石半岛与大陆相连。半岛长期是绕行非洲之角航路上的地标。出土的舶来陶器支持将此地认作古代贸易地点奥波涅的判断，西印度洋水手曾知晓这个港口。近海索马里洋流随季风改变方向。

english: Cape Hatteras marks a sharp bend in the sandy barrier islands of the Outer Banks. Offshore, the Gulf Stream turns away from the coast, while the shifting Diamond Shoals and frequent storms endanger ships rounding the cape. The name Hatrask was recorded for an inlet in 1585 during an English expedition associated with the Roanoke colony; it later came to be applied to the island and cape. A lighthouse was built here in 1803 to guide mariners past the dangerous coast.
simp_chinese: 哈特拉斯角是外滩群岛沙质屏障岛上一处明显的转折。海角外，墨西哥湾流离开海岸，变动的钻石浅滩与频繁风暴则威胁着绕行的船只。1585年，与罗阿诺克殖民计划有关的英国远征队将附近海口记为哈特拉斯克，后来这个名字也用于岛屿与海角。1803年，这里建起灯塔，引导航海者避开危险海岸。

english: Cape Henrietta Maria is a low, narrow peninsula at the northwestern entrance to James Bay, where its coast turns towards Hudson Bay. Built of crumbling limestone, it projects only a few metres above the water. The surrounding lowlands belong to the homeland of the Omushkego Cree. In September 1631, the navigator Thomas James sighted the cape during his search for a northwest passage and named it for Queen Henrietta Maria. He continued south along James Bay and spent a difficult winter at Charlton Island.
simp_chinese: 亨利埃塔·玛丽亚角是詹姆斯湾西北入口处一座低矮狭长的半岛，海岸在此转向哈得孙湾。岬角由风化石灰岩构成，高出水面只有几米；周围低地是奥穆什基戈克里人的家园。1631年9月，航海家托马斯·詹姆斯寻找西北航道时望见此岬，以王后亨利埃塔·玛丽亚为它命名。此后他沿詹姆斯湾西岸南行，在查尔顿岛艰难度过了冬季。

english:
Cape Hope Islands sit in the middle of James Bay, south of the old fur-trading station at Old Factory. The islands lie in the shallow southern reach of Hudson Bay, where river water mixes with a cold inland sea that freezes late in winter. Muddy water, tidal movement and shifting ice make the surrounding passages difficult, while the islands themselves offer only small and exposed landing places.

At the time of European contact, Cree peoples lived along both shores of James Bay. They moved seasonally across the interior and coast, hunting, fishing and gathering in country organized around watersheds and family territories. Cape Hope lay near routes that linked the east shore of James Bay with the rivers draining inland. The islands' name belongs to the maritime geography later used by European traders, not to a large permanent settlement.

The Hudson's Bay Company entered James Bay in the late seventeenth century. Its posts drew Cree hunters and homeguard families into the fur trade, exchanging furs and country food for imported goods. Sloops supplied the Eastmain coast and carried trade between scattered establishments. By 1837 the Cape Hope Islands remained a minor island group within this commercial waterway: valued for passage, shelter and access to surrounding hunting grounds rather than as a port.
simp_chinese:
希望角群岛位于詹姆斯湾中部，旧工厂旧毛皮站以南。群岛处在哈得孙湾南部的浅水区，河水与寒冷的陆间海在此交汇，海面直到冬季晚期仍可能结冰。混浊水色、潮汐流动和漂移冰情使周围水道难以通行，岛屿本身也只有狭小而暴露的登陆处。

欧洲人接触这一地区时，詹姆斯湾两岸居住着克里人。他们依照水系与家族领地，在内陆和海岸之间季节性迁徙，从事狩猎、捕鱼和采集。希望角邻近连接詹姆斯湾东岸和内陆诸河的路线。群岛之名后来进入欧洲商人的海图，但其海域并不是一座大型常设聚落。

十七世纪后期，哈德逊湾公司进入詹姆斯湾。商站吸引克里猎人和“守站者”家庭参与毛皮贸易，以皮张和乡野食物交换进口货物。单桅帆船为东梅恩海岸的商站运送补给，并在分散据点之间往来。到1837年，希望角群岛仍是这条商业水道中的小岛群，其价值在于通行、避风与接近周围猎场，而非港口。

english:
Cape Jask is a low, sandy headland on Iran's Makran coast, near the eastern entrance to the Gulf of Oman. The cape can be recognized by a square rock a few miles north and rises from a dry coastal plain toward broken inland hills. Offshore waters support fish but offer few obvious natural shelters.

Balochi and Persian names attach to the port, and historical geographers used the cape to mark where the Persian coast and Makran met. The Gulf of Oman, formerly known as the Makran Sea, joined the Arabian Sea with the Strait of Hormuz and Persian Gulf. Coastal inhabitants fished, cultivated dates and grain where water allowed, and carried goods across arid routes.

English traders made Jask a commercial base in the early seventeenth century. An East India Company ship arrived from India in 1616, and a trading post followed in 1619. English factories used the port to reach markets in Iran until nearby Bandar Abbas took over much of that trade. Portuguese attempts to block access led to fighting around the cape in the 1620s.

Unlike the narrow Strait of Hormuz, the approach to Jask was open to monsoon winds, pearl banks and fishing grounds, but exposed to heat, drought and sudden storms. Its value came from its position on maritime routes between India, Arabia and the Persian interior rather than from a broad hinterland.
simp_chinese:
贾斯克角是伊朗莫克兰海岸上一处低矮的沙质岬角，靠近阿曼湾东端。岬角北面数英里处有一块方形岩石，可用来辨认地貌；干燥沿海平原由此向破碎的内陆丘陵抬升。近海盛产鱼类，却缺少天然避风港。

当地同时使用俾路支语和波斯语地名，历史地理学者则以这个岬角标示波斯海岸与莫克兰的交界。旧称莫克兰海的阿曼湾，把阿拉伯海同霍尔木兹海峡及波斯湾连接起来。沿岸居民捕鱼，在有水处种植椰枣和谷物，并沿干旱道路运输货物。

十七世纪初，英国商人把贾斯克变成商业据点。1616年，一艘东印度公司船从印度抵达，1619年又设立商站。英国商馆通过这里进入伊朗市场，直到阿巴斯港接替了大部分贸易。葡萄牙人试图封锁航路，导致十七世纪二十年代在岬角周边发生战斗。

与狭窄的霍尔木兹海峡不同，贾斯克的外海航路受季风、珍珠浅滩和渔场影响，也暴露于酷热、干旱与风暴。它的价值来自印度、阿拉伯与波斯内陆之间的海上位置，腹地有限。

english: These Atlantic waters lie between Cape Juby on the African coast and Jandía, the mountainous peninsula at the southern end of Fuerteventura. The Canary Current flows past the islands, carrying cool water southward along the northwest African margin. In 1405 Ayoze, the ruler of Jandía, submitted to Jean de Béthencourt during the conquest of Fuerteventura, bringing the island under Castilian lordship.
simp_chinese: 这片大西洋水域位于非洲海岸的朱比角与富埃特文图拉岛南端多山的汉迪亚半岛之间。加那利洋流流经群岛，沿非洲西北缘向南输送凉水。1405年，在富埃特文图拉岛的征服过程中，汉迪亚统治者阿约塞向让·德·贝当古归附，岛屿随之处于卡斯蒂利亚领主统治下。

english: Cape Kaambooni projects into the Indian Ocean at the southern end of the Somali coast. Nearby lie low islands, reefs and sandy shores along the maritime route toward the Swahili ports of eastern Africa. The sea connects these coastal communities, but changing winds and shallow approaches require careful navigation. Offshore waters open eastward across the Indian Ocean, beyond the sheltered channels among the islands.
simp_chinese: 坎博尼角在索马里海岸南端伸入印度洋。附近有低平岛屿、礁石和沙岸，海路沿岸通向东非斯瓦希里港口。海洋连接这些沿岸社群，但变化的风向和浅水入口要求船只谨慎航行。岛间避风水道之外，近海向东通往开阔的印度洋。

english: Cape Kait projects from the eastern coast of Sumatra towards Bangka Island. It stands at the southern approach to the Bangka Strait, where the waters open into the Java Sea. The cape, also called Lucipara Point, was a landmark on the coast facing the channels and islands through which ships sailed between Sumatra and the Java Sea.
simp_chinese: 凯特角从苏门答腊东岸伸向邦加岛，位于邦加海峡南侧入口，水道在此通向爪哇海。这处岬角又称卢西帕拉角，是沿岸的一处航海地标；船只经过岛屿之间的水道，往来于苏门答腊与爪哇海。

english: The Makran coast borders the Gulf of Oman in a succession of capes, bays and dry coastal plains. Wind and waves shape sandy ridges around the bays, while rocky headlands project into the sea. The coast faces Arabia across the gulf and provides anchorages for fishers and traders travelling between the Strait of Hormuz and the shores of the Indian Ocean.
simp_chinese: 马克兰海岸濒临阿曼湾，由岬角、海湾和干燥平原交替组成。风浪在海湾周围塑造沙脊，岩石岬地伸入海中。海岸隔海面对阿拉伯，为往来霍尔木兹海峡与印度洋沿岸的渔民和商人提供锚地。

english: Cape Kamenjak marks the southern tip of Istria, jutting into the northern Adriatic beyond Premantura. Its position commanded a broad view of the surrounding country and sea. People occupied this narrow peninsula in prehistoric times, leaving hillfort sites on either side of Premantura. In the Middle Ages the area belonged to Pula; a settlement near Premantura may have been abandoned after outbreaks of plague in the 15th and 16th centuries.
simp_chinese: 卡梅尼亚克角位于伊斯特拉半岛最南端，从普雷曼图拉向外伸入亚得里亚海北部，可眺望广阔的周边陆地和海面。史前时期便有人居住在这片狭长半岛上，普雷曼图拉南北都留下了山地堡垒遗址。中世纪时，这一带属于普拉；普雷曼图拉附近的一处聚落可能在15至16世纪的瘟疫之后被遗弃。

english: Southeastern Borneo faces the Java Sea and the island passages around Laut. The low coast is broken by river mouths and inlets, while Laut Island stands off the mainland across a strait. Farther east the waters lead into the Makassar Strait between Borneo and Sulawesi.
simp_chinese: 婆罗洲东南部面向爪哇海及劳特岛附近的水道。低平海岸河口与海湾交错，劳特岛隔海峡坐落在大陆岸外。更东面的水域通向婆罗洲与苏拉威西之间的望加锡海峡。

english: The African coast of the southern Red Sea is fringed by coral reefs and offshore islands. South of Suakin, reef complexes extend along a dry shore backed by hills and plains. Shallow waters shelter fish and other marine life, while channels between the reefs permit boats to approach the land. Navigation along this coast requires attention to the reefs as well as seasonal winds.
simp_chinese: 红海南部非洲海岸外缘分布珊瑚礁和近海岛屿。萨瓦金以南，礁群沿干燥海岸伸展，岸后是丘陵与平原。浅水为鱼类等海洋生物提供庇护，礁间水道则让船只靠近陆地。沿岸航行须留意礁石与季节风，也需要熟悉能够安全进入的水道。

english: Cape Kerempe, known in antiquity as Carambis, juts northward from the Paphlagonian coast into the Black Sea. Its rocky headland was a prominent landmark for sailors following the southern shore. Across the water lies Cape Sarych in Crimea; the passage between the two headlands offered one of the shorter crossings of the sea. Coastal mountains rise behind Kerempe, leaving a narrow strip of land beside the water.
simp_chinese: 凯伦佩角古称卡兰比斯，从帕夫拉戈尼亚海岸向北伸入黑海。岩石岬角是沿南岸航行的水手辨认方向的重要标志。海对岸是克里米亚的萨雷奇角，两岬之间的航程是横渡黑海较短的路线之一。海角背后山地耸立，水边只留下一条狭窄地带。

english: Cape Kidurong projects from the Sarawak coast of northwestern Borneo near Bintulu. It faces the South China Sea, where rivers from the island's forested interior reach the coast. Along this shore, headlands and river mouths break the long stretch of land between the sea and Borneo's inland mountains.
simp_chinese: 基杜龙角位于婆罗洲西北部砂拉越海岸，靠近民都鲁，向南海伸出。来自岛上森林腹地的河流在这一带抵达海岸。岬角与河口分割着大海和婆罗洲内陆山地之间的漫长岸线。

english: Java's northern shore lies between the shallow Java Sea and a chain of volcanic mountains inland. Rivers cross the coastal plain and reach the sea through estuaries, while headlands mark the coast between the island's ports. The waters to the north lead towards Borneo and the islands scattered between the two shores.
simp_chinese: 爪哇北岸位于浅浅的爪哇海与内陆火山链之间。河流穿越沿海平原，经河口入海，岬角标记着岛上港口之间的海岸。北方水域通向婆罗洲及两岸之间散布的岛屿。

english: The southern coast of Sumatra faces the Indian Ocean near the western approach to the Sunda Strait. Bays and headlands interrupt the shore as the island turns towards Java. Pepper from the western Sumatran coast attracted merchants and rival powers, while ships passing the southern end of the island could enter the strait on their way to the Java Sea.
simp_chinese: 苏门答腊南部海岸面向印度洋，靠近巽他海峡西侧入口。岛屿向爪哇方向转折，沿岸海湾与岬角交错。苏门答腊西岸的胡椒吸引了商人和彼此竞争的势力；船只经过岛屿南端后，可以进入海峡，驶向爪哇海。

english: The western coast of northern Sumatra faces a chain of islands in the Indian Ocean. Among the mainland ports was Barus, known for camphor gathered in forests inland and carried overseas by merchants. The shore's bays and headlands lie between the sea and the mountains of Sumatra, while Nias and other islands stand farther offshore.
simp_chinese: 苏门答腊北部西岸面向印度洋上的一串岛屿。大陆沿岸港口包括巴鲁斯，以内陆森林采集的樟脑闻名，商人将这种物产运往海外。海岸的海湾与岬角位于大海和苏门答腊山地之间，尼亚斯等岛屿则坐落在更远的近海。

english: At the western extremity of Anatolia, Cape Lecton projects into the Aegean from the Troad. The headland appears in Homer's #italic Iliad#! and in the works of ancient geographers; a lighthouse called Lekton was recorded here in classical times. The #italic Acts of the Apostles#! describes Paul's companions sailing around the cape to Assos while he traveled there overland. The Ottoman navigator Piri Reis later recorded a saint's grave at the site in his #italic Book of the Sea#!.
simp_chinese: 莱克顿角从安纳托利亚西端的特洛伊地区伸入爱琴海。这处岬角见于荷马的《伊利亚特》和古代地理学家的著作；古典时期此处有一座名为莱克顿的灯塔。《使徒行传》记载，保罗的同伴乘船绕过海角前往阿索斯，保罗本人则走陆路。后来，奥斯曼航海家皮里·雷斯在《海洋之书》中记下了此地一位圣人的坟墓。

english:
Cape Ledo forms a broad Atlantic bay south of Luanda, where white beaches run beneath high coastal cliffs. Freshwater streams reach the sea through dry country, and fish gather along the shore. The bay offered shelter from the open ocean without providing a broad river route into the interior.

In 1648 a Portuguese fleet from Brazil landed here to recover Angola after seven years of Dutch control of Luanda. The operation depended on a suitable beach and landing ground close to the capital. The restored Portuguese government then tied the coast more firmly to Atlantic shipping and the inland slave trade. The landing fleet brought soldiers and supplies from Brazil for the campaign launched toward Luanda.

Fishing and small coastal traffic remained more important to daily life than the brief military landing. Cabo Ledo was known to sailors as a landmark, but its arid surroundings and cliffs limited settlement. The bay combined a usable shore with a difficult hinterland, making it a place of approach and modest provisioning rather than a major port.
simp_chinese:
莱多角在罗安达以南形成一片宽阔的大西洋海湾，白色沙滩分布在沿海高崖之下。淡水流经干旱地区入海，鱼群聚集在岸外。海湾为船只提供避开外洋的落脚处，却没有宽阔河道直通内陆。

1648年，一支来自巴西的葡萄牙舰队在这里登陆，意在结束荷兰对罗安达的七年控制并收复安哥拉。此次行动依赖首都附近可用的海滩和登陆地。葡萄牙政府恢复统治后，海岸同大西洋航运以及内地奴隶贸易联系得更加紧密。

对当地日常生活而言，捕鱼和小规模沿岸运输比短暂军事登陆更为重要。莱多角是水手辨认海岸的地标，但干旱环境与高崖限制了聚落规模。这片海湾兼具可用滩岸和难以进入的腹地，更像接近与补给地点，而非大型港口。

english: The waters east of northern Halmahera and Morotai open into the Halmahera Sea. Morotai stands north of the larger island, separated from it by a strait, while Halmahera's long peninsulas enclose deep bays farther south. Beyond these coasts the sea stretches towards the Pacific and the islands of western New Guinea.
simp_chinese: 哈马黑拉北部与摩罗泰以东的水域通向哈马黑拉海。摩罗泰坐落在较大的哈马黑拉岛北方，两岛之间隔着海峡；更南方哈马黑拉狭长的半岛环抱深湾。海岸之外，海域延伸至太平洋与新几内亚西部诸岛。

english: Cape Lelar lies on the western side of the Aru Islands, where low wooded shores face the sea towards the Banda Islands. The archipelago is cut by channels that allow small boats to move between its coasts. Pearls, sea cucumbers and tortoiseshell drew traders from Banda and Makassar to Aru, joining these distant islands to the maritime trade of eastern Indonesia.
simp_chinese: 莱拉角位于阿鲁群岛西侧，低平而多林的海岸面向通往班达群岛的海域。岛间水道纵横，小船得以在各处海岸之间穿行。珍珠、海参和玳瑁吸引班达与望加锡的商人来到阿鲁，将这些遥远岛屿纳入印度尼西亚东部的海上贸易。

english: Off south-western Sakhalin, the Strait of Tartary separates the island from the Asian mainland. The Krillon Peninsula projects southwards towards the strait joining the Sea of Japan and the Sea of Okhotsk. In 1787 La Pérouse sailed north along Sakhalin's western shore, but turned back without finding the shallow passage at its northern end.
simp_chinese: 库页岛西南岸外，鞑靼海峡将海岛与亚洲大陆分开。克里利翁半岛向南伸出，邻近连接日本海与鄂霍次克海的水道。1787年，拉彼鲁兹沿库页岛西岸向北航行，但未能找到北端的浅水通道便折返。

english:
Cape Lopez is the westernmost point of Gabon, a low forested cape at the northern end of Mandji Island in the Ogooué delta. Several distributaries, lagoons and mangrove channels surround it, joining the great West African river to the equatorial Atlantic. The open sea and river mouths make the cape easy to identify from offshore.

The Portuguese navigator Lopo Gonçalves reached the headland around 1480 and left it his name. By the sixteenth century it had become a point of commerce between coastal African traders and European ships. Captives, ivory, food and imported manufactures moved through the mouths of the delta, while local rulers controlled access to inland networks. Local rulers drew wealth from tolls and access to inland markets, giving the headland importance beyond its modest size.

Sailing conditions around the point were difficult, with shallow bars, currents and heavy rain. Ships often used the cape as a landmark while searching for routes toward the Gabon estuary and the coast farther south. Its historic importance lay in that meeting of river commerce and open-ocean navigation.
simp_chinese:
洛佩斯角是加蓬最西端，位于曼吉岛北端，是一处低矮而林木覆盖的海岬。奥果韦河三角洲的几股分流、潟湖和红树林水道环绕周围，把西非大河与赤道大西洋连接起来；海船在远处即可辨认这个岬角。地方统治者借通行费与内地市场的准入积累财富，使这个不大的岬角具有超出外观的重要性。

葡萄牙航海者洛波·贡萨尔维斯约在1480年抵达此地，岬角因此得名。到十六世纪，这里已成为非洲沿岸商人与欧洲船只交换货物的地点。俘虏、象牙、食物和进口制品经三角洲河口流通，地方统治者则控制通往内地商路的机会。

岬角周围有浅沙洲、洋流与频繁降雨，航行并不轻松。船只常将其作为寻找加蓬河口及南方海岸的定位地标。早在上世纪才出现的石油港城以前，这里的历史意义已来自河运与远洋航行的交汇。

english: Along northeastern Somalia, dry headlands look out over the Indian Ocean and the waters south of Cape Hafun. The Somali Current reverses with the monsoon, flowing strongly northward during the southwest monsoon. Cold water rises from below near the coast, bringing nutrients to the surface. The resulting productive sea contrasts with the arid hills and sandy shore behind it.
simp_chinese: 索马里东北部的干燥岬地面向印度洋及哈丰角以南水域。索马里洋流随季风转向，西南季风期间强劲向北流动。近岸深层冷水上涌，将养分带到表面。富饶的海洋与岸后的干旱丘陵和沙岸形成鲜明对比。

english: The northern coast of Hispaniola faces the Atlantic, with headlands and bays looking towards the Turks and Caicos banks. Spanish accounts distinguished the regions of Upper and Lower Macorix along this part of the island; the latter included the country around Monte Cristi and the Royal Plain. These shores formed part of the world of Indigenous communities before Spanish colonisation transformed the island’s settlements and population.
simp_chinese: 伊斯帕尼奥拉北岸面向大西洋，海角与海湾朝向特克斯和凯科斯浅滩。西班牙记述将岛上这一带区分为上、下马科里斯地区，后者包括蒙特克里斯蒂及皇家平原附近。西班牙殖民改变岛上聚落与人口之前，这些海岸属于原住民社群生活的世界。

english: Cape Magroua projects from the Algerian coast into the western Mediterranean. East of the cape, the shoreline bends into a bay bordered by a beach, with Colombi Island lying off the point at its far end. The sea stretches north towards Iberia and west towards the Alboran Sea and the Strait of Gibraltar. Through that strait Atlantic surface water enters the Mediterranean, while saltier water flows outward at depth.
simp_chinese: 马格鲁阿角从阿尔及利亚海岸伸入西地中海。海角以东，岸线弯成一处海湾，湾边是沙滩，另一端岬角外有科隆比岛。海面向北延伸至伊比利亚，向西通往阿尔沃兰海与直布罗陀海峡。大西洋表层水经海峡流入地中海，盐度较高的深层海水则向外流出。

english: Cape May marks the northern side of the entrance to Delaware Bay, where sandy shores meet the Atlantic. Henry Hudson sailed into the bay in 1609, and the cape later took the name of the Dutch navigator Cornelius Jacobsen Mey. By the late seventeenth century, shore whalers watched these waters for passing whales and launched small boats in pursuit. Their industry formed part of an early maritime economy along the bay and the neighbouring coast.
simp_chinese: 五月角位于特拉华湾入口北侧，沙岸在此与大西洋相接。1609年，亨利·哈德逊驶入海湾；海角后来以荷兰航海者科内利斯·雅各布森·梅伊的名字命名。到十七世纪末，岸上捕鲸人守望过境鲸群，再放下小船追逐。捕鲸成为海湾及邻近海岸早期海上经济的一部分。

english: Cape Meganom extends from the southeastern Crimean coast east of Sudak. Its rugged slopes, small bays and offshore rocks stand above waters crossed by merchants for centuries. Nearby Sudak became a major trading and craft centre, later fortified by the Genoese. Amphorae found off Meganom testify to ships carrying goods from the Byzantine world to settlements along Crimea's southern shore.
simp_chinese: 梅加诺姆角从克里米亚东南岸伸向大海，位于苏达克以东。崎岖山坡、小海湾和离岸岩礁环绕着商船往来数百年的水域。附近苏达克发展为重要贸易与手工业中心，后来由热那亚人加固设防。海角附近发现的双耳陶罐，见证了船只从拜占庭世界向克里米亚南岸聚落运送货物。

english: Off the southwestern coast of Chios lies the shore of Mesta, one of the island's mastic villages. Inland, its narrow streets and fortified perimeter offered protection from raiders; the defenses were strengthened under Genoese rule between 1346 and 1566. The fragrant resin produced in southern Chios was valuable to successive rulers. During the violence of 1822 many people of Mesta were killed or captured, though some were released because of the importance of the mastic harvest.
simp_chinese: 希俄斯岛西南岸的梅斯塔是岛上乳香村庄之一。内陆村庄的狭窄街道和设防外围抵御袭击，1346年至1566年热那亚统治时期，防御设施得到加强。希俄斯南部出产的芳香树脂对历代统治者都很珍贵。1822年的暴行中，许多梅斯塔居民被杀或俘获；由于乳香生产的重要性，一些人后来获释。

english:
Cape Mesurado projects into the Atlantic near the mouth of the Saint Paul River. Portuguese sailors traded here with African merchants for malagueta pepper, the spice that gave the Grain Coast its name. The cape later became a base for the Atlantic slave trade; in 1815 an armed force sent from Sierra Leone seized ships and freed people held in its trading establishments.

In 1821 representatives of the American Colonization Society sought land here for a settlement of free African Americans. Local Dei and Bassa leaders negotiated with them, but the ruler Zolu Duma was pressured into accepting the sale. Settlers established their colony on the cape in 1822; it became the town of Monrovia. Scarce supplies, disease and conflict with neighbouring communities troubled its first years.
simp_chinese:
梅苏拉多角在圣保罗河河口附近伸入大西洋。葡萄牙水手曾在这里与非洲商人交换马拉盖塔椒，这种香料为谷物海岸带来了名字。海角后来成为大西洋奴隶贸易据点；1815年，塞拉利昂派来的武装力量扣押船只，解救了商站中被囚禁的人。

1821年，美国殖民协会的代表在此寻求土地，准备安置自由的非裔美国人。当地代伊人和巴萨人的首领与他们谈判，但统治者祖卢·杜马是在压力下同意出售土地的。移民于1822年在海角建立殖民地，后来发展为蒙罗维亚。最初几年，物资短缺、疾病与同邻近社群的冲突困扰着聚落。

english: Cape Misurata marks the western approach to the great gulf on Libya's Mediterranean coast. Ancient geographers knew the gulf as the Greater Syrtis, distinguishing it from the Lesser Syrtis farther west. Its broad curve and treacherous sandbanks gave it a formidable reputation among sailors. The land route around the gulf likewise crossed inhospitable country, following the coast and a chain of wells through a narrow corridor.
simp_chinese: 米苏拉塔角标示着利比亚地中海岸大海湾的西侧入口。古代地理学家称海湾为大锡尔提斯，以区别更西面的小锡尔提斯。宽广的湾弧和危险沙洲使它在水手中声名可畏。绕湾而行的陆路也要穿过荒凉地带，沿海岸与一连串水井组成的狭窄通道前进。

english:
Cape Mondego is the western tip of Serra da Boa Viagem, a steep limestone headland north of the Mondego estuary. Its cliffs expose rocks of the Lusitanian Basin and form a clear boundary between the river's shifting bar and open Atlantic. Offshore reefs and winter storms gave the point a dangerous reputation, while Buarcos Bay sheltered ships awaiting a safe crossing.

The sheltered estuary and nearby Buarcos supported fishing, salt production, shipbuilding and coastal trade. Its 1342 charter supported vessels carrying salt, fish and goods. During the sixteenth and seventeenth centuries, pirate attacks prompted fortifications around the estuary and made watch and defense part of the coast's daily order.

The cape itself had no deep harbor. Its height and seaward slope made it a landmark above the Mondego approaches, warning mariners of sandbanks and currents before they reached the river. Fishing and shipping concentrated below, around Buarcos and the growing settlement of Figueira, leaving the headland as a thinly built edge of cliffs, pinewoods and open water.
simp_chinese:
蒙德古角是博阿维亚任山向西伸出的陡峭石灰岩岬角，位于蒙德古河口以北。悬崖露出卢西塔尼亚盆地岩层，在河流不断移动的沙坝与开阔大西洋之间形成明确边界。外海暗礁和风暴令海角危险，南面的布阿尔库什湾为候潮船只避风。

河口与布阿尔库什支撑捕鱼、产盐、造船和沿岸贸易。布阿尔库什于1342年取得特许状，港口船只运出盐、鱼及其他货物。十六至十七世纪，海上袭击促使河口周边修筑防御，瞭望和守备成为沿岸生活的一部分。

海角本身没有深水港，却以高度和临海坡面成为蒙德古河口航路的地标，提醒来船注意沙洲与水流。捕鱼与航运集中在下方布阿尔库什和菲盖拉，海角上层保持稀疏建筑、松林与崖壁。

english: Cape Mount rises above the Atlantic coast near the mouth of the Mano River. Its prominent headland overlooks a coast of lagoons, wetlands and forest, inhabited by Vai and Gola communities. From the late eighteenth century the neighbouring Galinhas country became a centre of the Atlantic slave trade. Vai merchants and rulers dealt with European traders, while relationships of kinship and marriage helped bind foreign merchants to local ruling families. The trade brought wealth to some and forced captivity and exile upon many others.
simp_chinese: 芒特角耸立在大西洋岸边，靠近马诺河口。这处醒目的岬角俯瞰着潟湖、湿地与森林交错的海岸，瓦伊人和戈拉人居住于此。十八世纪末起，附近的加利尼亚斯地区成为大西洋奴隶贸易中心。瓦伊商人与统治者同欧洲商人交易，亲属和婚姻关系也将外来商人与当地统治家族联系起来。这门贸易使一些人获利，却迫使许多人遭受奴役和流放。

english: Cape Mount rises above the Atlantic coast near a country of lagoons and river mouths. Vai traditions recall a migration from the Mande interior to this shore and the neighbouring Gallinas, commonly placed in the sixteenth century. The cape became a place of exchange between African traders and ships from overseas. By the late eighteenth century it was an established centre of the Atlantic slave trade, while traders also began to seek captives farther west along the Gallinas River.
simp_chinese: 芒特角耸立于大西洋岸边，附近是一片潟湖与河口交错的地区。瓦伊人的传统记述祖先从曼德内陆迁来这片海岸及邻近的加利纳斯，通常将这次迁徙置于十六世纪。海角成为非洲商人与海外船只交换货物的地方。到十八世纪末，这里已是大西洋奴隶贸易的固定据点，而商人也开始在更西面的加利纳斯河沿岸寻求被俘者。

english: Ras Muhammad marks the southern tip of Sinai, where the Red Sea divides into the Gulf of Suez to the west and the Gulf of Aqaba to the east. Coral reefs rise close to the headland, sheltering abundant fish in clear water. The cape is a landmark for vessels entering either gulf, while reefs and currents make its approaches demanding. Behind the shore, the mountains and desert of Sinai stretch northward.
simp_chinese: 穆罕默德角位于西奈半岛南端，红海在此分为西面的苏伊士湾和东面的亚喀巴湾。珊瑚礁紧邻岬角，在清澈海水中庇护众多鱼类。海角是驶入两湾船只的地标，礁石和水流却使靠近时颇具挑战。岸后西奈的山地与沙漠向北延伸。

english: The eastern Banda Sea lies among the islands that separate its deep waters from the shallower Arafura Sea. The Banda Islands to the north were famous for nutmeg and mace, while traders sailing east reached Aru in search of pearls and other valuable products. Island coasts and open crossings together formed the routes by which these goods moved across eastern Indonesia.
simp_chinese: 班达海东部散布着众多岛屿，将深海与较浅的阿拉弗拉海分隔开来。北方的班达群岛以肉豆蔻和肉豆蔻皮闻名，向东航行的商人则抵达阿鲁，寻找珍珠等贵重物产。岛岸与开阔海面上的航程共同构成货物穿行印度尼西亚东部的路线。

english: Cape Ostrovnoy projects into the Sea of Japan east of the great bays of southern Primorye. Rocky headlands and small inlets interrupt a coast backed by the forested hills of the Sikhote-Alin. To the west the shore turns towards the islands and sheltered waters of the great gulf; to the northeast it continues along the mountainous mainland. The cape marks a point of land between open water and the smaller bays along this shore.
simp_chinese: 奥斯特罗夫角位于滨海地区南部大海湾以东，伸入日本海。岩石岬角和小海湾分布于海岸，后方是锡霍特山脉林木覆盖的丘陵。海岸向西转向大海湾的群岛和较为隐蔽的水域，向东北则继续沿山地大陆延伸。岬角处在开阔海面与沿岸小湾之间。

english:
Cape Palmas marks the southeastern end of Liberia's coast, where a rocky peninsula is tied to the mainland by a sandy isthmus. The Hoffman River estuary opens west of the point, and the Cavalla River reaches the sea farther east near the Ivory Coast border. After running southward for so long, West Africa's shoreline turns east here and enters the Gulf of Guinea.

Kru and Grebo communities used the estuary for fishing and coastal trade. Canoes followed surf lines, lagoons and river mouths, carrying fish, salt, rice and craft goods between settlements. Shoals around the cape made navigation difficult, while the protected water behind the point offered a landing place for small vessels.

Portuguese navigator Diogo Gomes named the feature Cabo das Palmas in 1458 during a voyage of trade and exploration. The name entered maps in several European languages. Local sailors continued to use their own knowledge of currents and landfalls, and the cape remained a conspicuous turning point where Atlantic voyages met the beginning of the Gulf of Guinea coast.
simp_chinese:
帕尔马斯角位于利比里亚海岸东南端。岩石半岛通过沙质地峡同大陆相连，霍夫曼河河口在岬角西侧，卡瓦拉河则在更东处、接近科特迪瓦边界的地方入海。西非海岸一路向南之后在此明确转向东方，进入几内亚湾。

克鲁人和格雷博人利用河口捕鱼和进行沿海贸易。独木舟沿浪线、潟湖和河口航行，在聚落之间运送鱼、盐、稻米和手工制品。岬角周围浅滩使航行困难，背后的避风水域又为小船提供登陆处。

1458年，葡萄牙航海者迪奥戈·戈麦斯在探索和贸易航程中把这里命名为棕榈角。名称随后以多种欧洲语言进入地图。地方航海者仍掌握自己的洋流与地标知识，岬角则继续作为大西洋航程和几内亚湾海岸起点上的醒目转折点。

english: Cape Pangkah lies on the northern coast of Java at the mouth of the Bengawan Solo. The river brings water and sediment from the island's interior to the Java Sea, building a low delta along the shore. Across the nearby waters lies Madura, while the coast to the south leads towards the ports of Gresik and Surabaya.
simp_chinese: 庞卡角位于爪哇北岸、梭罗河入海之处。河流将岛屿内陆的水和泥沙带入爪哇海，在岸边形成低平三角洲。附近水域对面是马都拉岛，沿岸向南则通往格雷西克和泗水的港口。

english: Cape Panjang projects from Sulawesi's northern peninsula into the Gulf of Tomini. To its south lie the Togian Islands, a chain of wooded islands stretching across the gulf. Mangrove swamps fringe parts of the cape's coast, providing habitat for saltwater crocodiles. Beyond the islands the shores of Sulawesi's eastern peninsula form the opposite side of the great inlet.
simp_chinese: 潘姜角从苏拉威西北部半岛伸入托米尼湾。其南方是托吉安群岛，一串森林茂密的岛屿横贯海湾。岬角部分海岸有红树林沼泽，是湾鳄的栖息地。群岛以南，苏拉威西东部半岛的海岸构成海湾另一侧。

english: Northwestern Borneo's Sarawak coast faces the South China Sea, with forested lands and river valleys behind it. The Baram River crosses this region and reaches the sea through a delta shaped by tides and sediment. Along the coast, bays, river mouths and headlands provide landmarks between the open sea and the island's interior.
simp_chinese: 婆罗洲西北部砂拉越海岸面向南海，后方是森林与河谷。巴拉姆河流经这一地区，经由潮汐和泥沙塑造的三角洲入海。沿岸海湾、河口与岬角构成大海和岛屿内陆之间的地标。

english: Cape Pazarbaşı projects from the southern Black Sea coast west of the Sakarya River. Ancient remains along the shore east of the cape include traces of settlements, a quarry and a former natural harbour. The headland and nearby offshore island marked the coast for vessels sailing between the Bosporus and the ports farther east. Rocky points and small inlets break the shoreline around it.
simp_chinese: 帕扎尔巴舍角从黑海南岸伸入海中，位于萨卡里亚河以西。海角东侧沿岸留有古代聚落、采石场和天然港湾的痕迹。往来于博斯普鲁斯与东部港口的船只可以海角和附近离岸岛屿辨认海岸；周围岸线分布着岩岬与小海湾。

english: Cape Peñas projects into the Cantabrian Sea at the northernmost point of Asturias. High cliffs and rocky islets face the Atlantic swell between the harbours of Avilés and Gijón. Heather covers the exposed headland, where winds and storms strike the coast with little shelter. To seafarers rounding northern Spain, the cape marks a prominent turn along a shore of steep rocks and small inlets.
simp_chinese: 佩尼亚斯角伸入坎塔布里亚海，是阿斯图里亚斯最北端。高耸悬崖与岩礁位于阿维莱斯和希洪港之间，迎向大西洋涌浪。无遮蔽的岬角生长着石南，风暴毫无遮挡地冲击海岸。对绕行西班牙北部的航海者而言，它是峭壁与小海湾交错的海岸上一处醒目的转折点。

english: Bangka Island lies off the eastern coast of Sumatra, separated from it by the Bangka Strait. The channel joins the waters towards the Strait of Malacca with the Java Sea, passing low shores and river mouths. Islands and shallow waters break the routes between Sumatra and the sea to its east.
simp_chinese: 邦加岛位于苏门答腊东岸外，邦加海峡将两者分开。水道经过低平海岸与河口，连接通往马六甲海峡的水域和爪哇海。岛屿与浅海分布在苏门答腊和东侧海域之间的航路上。

english: The southern coast of Buton faces the seas beyond Sulawesi's southeastern peninsula. Muna lies west across the Buton Strait, while the Tukang Besi Islands lie farther east. Buton stood on routes connecting Makassar with Maluku; in the seventeenth and eighteenth centuries its ports received ships carrying spices and exchanged goods produced in the region.
simp_chinese: 布顿岛南岸面向苏拉威西东南半岛之外的海域。穆纳岛位于布顿海峡以西，图康勿西群岛则在更远的东方。布顿处于连接望加锡与马鲁古的航线上；十七、十八世纪，其港口接待运载香料的船只，也交换地区物产。

english: The mainland shore of the Strait of Tartary is broken by capes and river mouths. Near Cape Peschanyy, the Koppi enters Andreya Bay after descending from the Sikhote-Alin. Breakers form across the approach to the river mouth, while the bay's southern headland offers some shelter from the swell.
simp_chinese: 鞑靼海峡的大陆海岸岬角与河口相间。佩沙内角附近，科皮河从锡霍特山脉流下，注入安德烈亚湾。河口外可见碎浪，海湾南侧的岬角则能略微遮挡涌浪。

english: Cape Pitt lies among the western Solomon Islands, where reef-fringed coasts and channels connect neighbouring islands. Their communities had long navigated these waters before European ships arrived. In 1768 Louis-Antoine de Bougainville sailed through the western Solomon region and named Choiseul.
simp_chinese: 皮特角位于所罗门群岛西部，珊瑚礁环绕的海岸与水道连接着邻岛。欧洲船只到来之前，当地社群长期航行于这些水域。1768年，路易-安托万·德·布干维尔航经所罗门群岛西部地区，为舒瓦瑟尔岛命名。

english:
Cape Race is a flat, rocky headland at the southeastern tip of Newfoundland's Avalon Peninsula. Its cliffs rise thirty metres from the Atlantic, and dense fog covers the cape on many days. The position made it a landfall and navigational marker for ships crossing from Europe. Portuguese charts called it Cabo Raso, a name probably describing the low, flat point rather than the prevailing weather.

From the sixteenth century, fishing fleets from Portugal, England, France and Spain worked the rich waters around Newfoundland. Cape Race lay beside their routes, while the island's Beothuk people increasingly withdrew inland as European fishing stations and settlement expanded. In 1583 Sir Humphrey Gilbert sailed past the cape after claiming St John's; his ship Squirrel later sank with him on the return voyage. No permanent town developed at Cape Race during the EU5 period. Its history belongs instead to navigation, seasonal fisheries and the dangerous meeting of Atlantic routes with a fogbound coast.
simp_chinese:
雷斯角是纽芬兰阿瓦隆半岛东南端一处低平多岩的海角，峭壁从大西洋水面拔起约三十米，浓雾每年在许多日子笼罩海岸。这个位置使它成为欧洲横渡船只的天然登陆与导航标志。葡萄牙海图称其为“Cabo Raso”，名称大概描述低平地形，并非天气。

十六世纪起，葡萄牙、英格兰、法国和西班牙渔船在纽芬兰附近富饶水域作业。雷斯角位于这些航路旁；欧洲渔站和定居点扩展时，岛上的贝奥图克人日益退向内陆。1583年，汉弗莱·吉尔伯特在宣布占有圣约翰后驶过此角，他的“松鼠”号在返航途中沉没，吉尔伯特也随之失踪。EU5时代，雷斯角始终没有形成永久城镇，它的历史属于航海、季节渔业以及大西洋航线与多雾海岸的危险交会。

english: Cape Radja marks a point on the western coast of northern Sumatra, where the shore faces the Indian Ocean. The coast bends around bays and headlands towards Aceh in the north, while islands lie offshore. Ships travelling along this coast passed between the ocean and the mountainous interior, seeking the ports that served Sumatra's trade.
simp_chinese: 拉惹角位于苏门答腊北部西岸，面向印度洋。海岸穿过一系列海湾与岬角向北延伸至亚齐，近海则有岛屿。沿岸航行的船只穿过大洋与多山内陆之间的水域，寻找参与苏门答腊贸易的港口。

english: Cape Rajah, also known as Ujung Raja, juts into the waters off the northern coast of Sumatra. The headland lies on the Acehnese shore facing the western approaches to the Strait of Malacca. This coast stood beside a major route between the Indian Ocean and the South China Sea, travelled by merchants who called at the ports of northern Sumatra.
simp_chinese: 拉贾角又称乌戎拉贾，伸入苏门答腊北岸外的海水。这处岬角位于亚齐海岸，面向马六甲海峡西侧的入口。一条连接印度洋与南海的重要航路经过这里，商人沿途在苏门答腊北部的港口停靠。

sources.title: the establisment of islamic rule in eastern coast of sumatra.pdf

english:
Cape Rangas faces the narrow seaways of the Moluccas, where forested volcanic islands divide the sea into channels and sheltered anchorages. Colliding plates produce earthquakes, uplift and active volcanoes, while reefs and sudden monsoon weather demand local knowledge from sailors.

Cloves, nutmeg and mace made the islands a destination for long-distance trade. Island communities exchanged spices, forest products, fish and cloth with Javanese, Malay and Arab merchants. Islam spread through the ports alongside older beliefs, and markets linked the archipelago with the Indian Ocean and South China Sea.

Portuguese ships entered the spice trade in the early sixteenth century, followed by Spanish and Dutch rivals. Forts and exclusive treaties tried to control production, but cultivation remained dispersed among island communities. Cape Rangas thus overlooks a sea where colonization competed with established routes and a spice economy reached distant markets.
simp_chinese:
朗阿斯角面向摩鹿加狭窄海道，森林火山岛把海面分成水道与避风锚地。板块碰撞造成地震、抬升和活火山，珊瑚礁与突发季风又要求航行者具备地方知识。

丁香、肉豆蔻与肉豆蔻衣使群岛成为远途贸易目的地。岛民同爪哇、马来和阿拉伯商人交换香料、林产、鱼类与布匹。伊斯兰教通过港市传播并与旧信仰并存，市场把群岛同印度洋和南海联系起来。

十六世纪初葡萄牙进入香料贸易，随后西班牙与荷兰竞争。堡垒和排他条约试图控制生产，种植业仍分散在各岛。朗阿斯角所见海域因此同时承载板块碰撞、文化交流、殖民争夺与既有航路，也把地方香料经济同远达印度洋、南海和欧洲的市场连接起来。

english: Cape Range forms the spine of North West Cape, with the waters of Ningaloo Reef close to its western shore and Exmouth Gulf to the east. Baiyungu and Yinnigurrura people have longstanding connections to this coastal country. In 1618 the Dutch ship Mauritius reached the wider cape and gulf region.
simp_chinese: 开普山脉构成西北角的脊梁，西岸附近是宁加洛礁水域，东面则是埃克斯茅斯湾。拜云古人和伊尼古鲁拉人长期与这片海岸土地保持联系。1618年荷兰船只毛里求斯号抵达这一岬角和海湾所在的地区。

english: Cape Saint Paul lies on the coast east of the Volta's mouth, near the lagoons and settlements of the Anlo Ewe. In the eighteenth century Anlo power extended across the lower Volta and brought its rulers into conflict with the Danes and their African allies. After Anlo's defeat in 1784, a treaty permitted the Danes to build Fort Prinzenstein at nearby Keta. Fishing settlements, lagoon traffic and trade linked the cape's shore to the wider delta.
simp_chinese: 圣保罗角位于伏尔塔河口以东的海岸，靠近安洛埃维人的潟湖与聚落。十八世纪，安洛势力扩展到伏尔塔河下游，其统治者与丹麦人及其非洲盟友发生冲突。1784年安洛战败后，和约允许丹麦人在附近的凯塔修建普林岑施泰因堡。渔村、潟湖交通与贸易将海角附近的海岸同整个三角洲联系起来。

english: Off eastern Luzon, the waters around San Ildefonso face a peninsula that shelters Casiguran Sound from the Philippine Sea. Reefs line the sound, while Motiong Point marks the narrowing towards Casiguran Bay. Behind this indented coast rise the wooded mountains of the Sierra Madre.
simp_chinese: 在吕宋东部外海，圣伊尔德丰索附近的水域面向一座半岛，它为卡西古兰湾遮挡菲律宾海。礁石沿海湾分布，莫蒂翁角标志着通往卡西古兰内湾的狭窄处。这片曲折海岸后方耸立着林木覆盖的马德雷山脉。

english: Cape São Vicente marks the southwestern corner of mainland Europe, where Portugal's Atlantic coast turns east along the Algarve. Its cliffs overlook waters crossed by ships travelling between the Atlantic and the Strait of Gibraltar. On 14 February 1797 a British fleet under John Jervis met a larger Spanish fleet off the cape. The British victory became one of the notable naval encounters of the war, fought near a headland long familiar to sailors rounding the Iberian Peninsula.
simp_chinese: 圣维森特角标志着欧洲大陆的西南端，葡萄牙大西洋海岸在此转向东方，沿阿尔加维延伸。海角峭壁俯瞰着大西洋与直布罗陀海峡之间的船只必经水域。1797年2月14日，约翰·杰维斯率领的英国舰队在角外遭遇规模更大的西班牙舰队。英国的胜利成为战争中著名的海战之一，战场靠近这处长期为绕行伊比利亚半岛的水手所熟知的海角。

english: Off western New Guinea, the Raja Ampat islands lie between the Halmahera Sea and the Pacific. Their shores, reefs and channels form a complex archipelago east of Halmahera, where long peninsulas enclose deep bays. The waters connect Maluku with the coast of New Guinea and the islands beyond.
simp_chinese: 新几内亚西岸外，拉贾安帕特群岛位于哈马黑拉海与太平洋之间。岛岸、珊瑚礁和水道构成复杂群岛，哈马黑拉位于其西方，狭长半岛环抱深湾。这片水域将马鲁古与新几内亚海岸及更远岛屿相连。

english:
Cape Sarych projects from the southern tip of Crimea into the Black Sea. It lies south of Sevastopol, beneath the broken landscape of the Crimean Mountains. Across the water, Cape Kerempe on Turkey’s Anatolian coast is roughly 229 kilometres away, making this the sea’s shortest north-south crossing.

Sailors used Sarych as a landmark while turning along Crimea or steering toward the opposite shore. The Black Sea stretches between eastern Europe and Anatolia and receives the Danube, Dnieper and Dniester.

Heavy freshwater inflow creates a deep layer that mixes little with the surface salt water and therefore lacks oxygen, helping preserve ancient wrecks. Greek colonies linked its coasts in antiquity; Byzantine, Genoese, Ottoman and Russian powers later built different maritime systems around the same basin. Cape Sarych’s southern exposure places it within this long history of coastal settlement and cross-sea travel.
simp_chinese:
萨雷奇角从克里米亚半岛南端突出于黑海。它位于塞瓦斯托波尔以南，背靠克里米亚山地破碎的地形。水面对岸是土耳其安纳托利亚海岸的凯雷姆佩角，两地相距约二百二十九公里，构成黑海最短的南北横渡线。

沿克里米亚航行或驶向对岸的船只会把萨雷奇作为陆标。黑海位于东欧与安纳托利亚之间，接纳多瑙河、第聂伯河和德涅斯特河。

大量淡水形成深层水体，这一层极少与表层咸水混合，因缺氧而保存了许多古老沉船。古代希腊殖民地连接两岸，后来拜占庭、热那亚、奥斯曼和俄罗斯势力又在同一盆地建立各自的海上联系。萨雷奇角向南敞开，见证沿岸聚落和跨海航行的长期历史。

english: Southern Borneo faces the Java Sea, with rivers flowing from the island's interior across a low coastal plain. The Barito is among the great rivers reaching this shore, carrying water and sediment into the sea. To the east, island channels around Laut lead towards the Makassar Strait.
simp_chinese: 婆罗洲南岸面向爪哇海，河流从岛屿内陆穿过低平沿海平原入海。巴里托河是抵达这一海岸的大河之一，将水和泥沙带入大海。东方劳特岛附近的岛间水道通向望加锡海峡。

english: Cape Sena lies near New Ireland in the Bismarck archipelago, amid waters connecting volcanic islands and coral shores. Communities on these islands maintained local connections before European arrival. In 1616 the Dutch navigators Jacob Le Maire and Willem Schouten sighted the Anir islands to the east.
simp_chinese: 塞纳角位于俾斯麦群岛新爱尔兰附近，这片水域连接火山岛与珊瑚海岸。欧洲人到来之前，岛上社群已维持地方联系。1616年，荷兰航海家雅各布·勒梅尔和威廉·斯豪滕望见东面的阿尼尔群岛。

english: On the southern coast of Borneo, rivers flow from the island's interior to the Java Sea. The Sampit River reaches the shore through a broad estuary, where sediment and tides shape the low coast. Beyond the river mouth, open water extends south towards Java.
simp_chinese: 婆罗洲南岸的河流从内陆流向爪哇海。桑皮特河经宽阔河口抵达海岸，泥沙与潮汐共同塑造低平岸线。河口之外，开阔水域向南延伸至爪哇。

english: Cape Sicié rises above the Mediterranean west of Toulon, a rocky headland overlooking the approaches to the harbours of Provence. On its heights stands the chapel of Notre-Dame du Mai, looking out over the sea and the coast. It was built in 1625 after lightning struck a watchtower and its keeper's hut. The chapel became a place of devotion, its offerings recalling the prayers and gratitude of people who lived beside these waters.
simp_chinese: 西西耶角位于土伦以西，岩石岬角高耸于地中海之上，俯瞰通往普罗旺斯诸港的海路。高处的五月圣母礼拜堂面向海洋与海岸。1625年，雷电击中当地一座瞭望塔和守卫小屋，礼拜堂随后建成。这里成为祈祷之所，堂中的还愿物记载着沿海居民的祈求与感恩。

english: Cape Sim marks the Atlantic coast south of Essaouira, where dunes and rocky shores meet the open sea. The dunes extend towards the bay and the offshore islands of Mogador, whose shelter helped make the neighbouring harbour useful to shipping. Sultan Muhammad III established Essaouira as a port in the eighteenth century, drawing Moroccan and foreign merchants to a coast long exposed to the winds and currents of the eastern Atlantic.
simp_chinese: 西姆角位于索维拉以南的大西洋岸边，沙丘与岩岸在此面向外海。沙丘向北延伸至海湾和莫加多尔群岛，岛屿的遮蔽使附近港湾适合船只停泊。十八世纪，苏丹穆罕默德三世建立索维拉港，吸引摩洛哥和外国商人来到这段长期迎受大西洋东部风与洋流的海岸。

english: The Cape of Sines projects into the Atlantic on Portugal's Alentejo coast, dividing a long sandy shore to the north from the bay of Sines. Above the bay stands the town's castle, built to defend the coast and its inhabitants. Pedro I made Sines a town in 1362 on condition that its people continue the castle walls. The navigator Vasco da Gama grew up here, looking out over the same Atlantic that carried his expedition toward India.
simp_chinese: 锡尼什角伸入葡萄牙阿连特茹海岸外的大西洋，将北方漫长的沙岸与锡尼什湾分开。海湾上方矗立着为保护海岸及居民而修建的城堡。1362年，佩德罗一世将锡尼什升为城镇，条件是居民继续修筑城墙。航海家瓦斯科·达伽马在此长大，远望大西洋；后来他率领远征队从这片海洋驶向印度。

english: Off the mouth of the Rajang, Cape Sink faces the broad delta of Sarawak's great river. The Rajang divides into channels through low, waterlogged land before entering the South China Sea. Mangrove forests fringe the seaward edge, while sediment carried down the river builds the delta outward.
simp_chinese: 在拉让河口外，辛克角面向砂拉越大河形成的宽阔三角洲。拉让河分成多条水道，穿过低洼湿地后注入南中国海。红树林镶嵌海缘，河流带下的泥沙则使三角洲不断向外延伸。

english: The Sinop peninsula projects into the Black Sea from the Anatolian coast, sheltering a deep natural harbour on its southern side. The port of Sinop grew on the narrow isthmus joining it to the mainland. Medieval ships carried grain, wax and hides through the harbour, linking Anatolia with ports across the sea. Its sheltered anchorage made the peninsula a valuable refuge on a coast exposed to northern winds.
simp_chinese: 锡诺普半岛从安纳托利亚海岸伸入黑海，南侧有一处受庇护的深水天然港。锡诺普城生长在连接半岛与大陆的狭窄地峡上。中世纪船只经此运输粮食、蜂蜡和皮革，将安纳托利亚与海对岸港口相连。海湾避风的优势，使半岛成为面向北风海岸上的宝贵避泊处。

english:
Cape Sipang belongs to Riau’s coastal waters near the southern approach to the Strait of Malacca. Mangroves, mudbanks, small islands and shallow channels form a difficult coast where tides expose shifting routes. Local fishers used sheltered passages and river mouths linking the shore with Sumatra’s interior.

Malay chiefdoms grew wealthy from traffic through the strait. Srivijaya and later Malacca drew ships carrying Indian cloth, Chinese ceramics, rice, tin and forest products. Rulers taxed shipping and offered protection, while orang laut communities supplied pilots, crews and knowledge of shoals. Malay became the common language of ports across the archipelago.

Portuguese, Dutch and Acehnese powers contested Malacca in the sixteenth and seventeenth centuries. Dutch control of the main strait did not eliminate Riau’s smaller channels, which remained important for trade, fishing and migration. Cape Sipang joined a mangrove coast to one of the world’s busiest maritime corridors.
simp_chinese:
西潘角属于廖内沿海，靠近马六甲海峡南端。红树林、泥滩、小岛和浅水道构成难行海岸，潮汐不断改变路线。地方渔民利用受遮蔽水道与河口，把海岸同苏门答腊内陆相连。

马来酋邦借海峡交通致富。室利佛逝与马六甲吸引载运印度布匹、中国瓷器、稻米、锡和林产的船只。统治者征收航税并提供保护，海人族群则提供领航与浅滩知识。马来语成为群岛港市的通用语言。

十六、十七世纪，葡萄牙、荷兰与亚齐争夺马六甲。荷兰控制主海峡后，廖内的较小水道仍对贸易、渔业和迁徙重要。西潘角由此把红树林海岸接入全球繁忙航道。

english:
The waters around southeastern New Guinea lead toward Milne Bay, a deep harbor on the coast of Papua New Guinea. The bay extends more than thirty-five kilometres inland and remains over fifteen kilometres wide. Its entrance opens through Ward Hunt Strait into protected water behind the wooded Stirling Range. A narrow lowland strip on the northern shore gives way to wet sago and mangrove swamps. Open sea, a constricted approach and shelter thus lie close together.

Luis Váez de Torres surveyed the bay in July 1606, bringing the coast into the written record of European Pacific exploration. Malaria proved costly in the surrounding tropical lowlands. The same sheltered geography that aided shipping also created conditions for disease. Cape Siri belongs to this compact meeting of protected water, mountain wall and forested swamp. Fishing and canoe routes tied the headland to Milne Bay communities.
simp_chinese:
新几内亚东南端周围的海域通向巴布亚新几内亚的米尔恩湾。这座深水港湾向内陆延伸三十五公里以上，宽度超过十五公里，入口经沃德亨特海峡进入受斯特灵山脉林木包围的避风水域。北岸狭窄低地逐渐过渡为湿软的西谷椰子林和红树林沼泽，开阔海面、狭小入口与内湾静水相距很近。

1606年7月，路易斯·瓦斯·德托雷斯勘察米尔恩湾，使这里进入欧洲人记录太平洋的地理文献。周边热带低地的疟疾尤其令人畏惧，能够庇护船队的地形也形成利于疾病传播的环境。西里角所处的位置，正是受保护水域、山壁和森林沼泽紧密相接之处。渔业与独木舟航线把岬角同米尔恩湾社群联系在一起。

english: Cape Skiring faces the Atlantic near the mouth of the Casamance, a river whose channels wind among mangroves and low-lying fields. Communities of the lower river cultivated rice in a landscape shaped by tides and rain. Dikes protected fields from salt water, while farmers used the rains to wash salt from the soil. Portuguese traders visited the Casamance in the sixteenth century seeking wax, ivory and captives, entering a region already sustained by its own elaborate farming practices.
simp_chinese: 斯基林角面向大西洋，靠近卡萨芒斯河口。河道蜿蜒穿过红树林和低洼田地，下游社群在受潮汐与降雨影响的土地上种植稻米。堤坝保护稻田免遭海水侵入，农人还利用雨水洗去土壤中的盐分。十六世纪，葡萄牙商人来到卡萨芒斯寻购蜂蜡、象牙与被俘者；在此之前，精巧的农耕方法已支撑着当地社会。

english: Cape Smith is the western tip of Smith Island, off the eastern shore of Hudson Bay. Inuit know the island as Qikirtajuaq, a traditional hunting ground across the water from the coast of the Ungava Peninsula. The island's headland is a prominent landmark for travellers on the bay, while coves indent its southern shore. Nearby, the mainland forms a peninsula between two inlets, a shape that gave rise to the Inuit name Akulivik, recalling the central prong of a fishing spear.
simp_chinese: 史密斯角是哈得孙湾东岸外史密斯岛的西端。因纽特人称这座岛为基基尔塔朱阿克，岛上是传统猎场，隔水与昂加瓦半岛海岸相望。岛的岬角是湾上醒目的地标，南岸则分布着小湾。附近大陆有一座伸入两个海湾之间的半岛，其形状让因纽特人想起鱼叉中央的尖齿，因此得名阿库利维克。

english: Cape Sosunova lies off the northeastern Asian coast, where the sea meets the lowlands of the lower Amur and Ussuri. Jurchen peoples founded the Jin dynasty in 1115, and their successors, the Manchus, created the Qing state and brought the northeast into imperial administration. Coastal communities traded fish, furs and forest goods with river towns, and the sea linked the lower Amur and Ussuri country with Korea and the Japanese archipelago. Hunting, fishing, livestock keeping and farming made up a mixed economy among the Tungusic peoples of the region.
simp_chinese: 索苏诺瓦角位于东北亚海岸外，海洋在此与阿穆尔河与乌苏里江下游的低地相接。女真人于1115年建立金朝，其后继者满洲人创建清朝，把东北纳入帝国行政。沿海社群与河畔城镇交换鱼类、毛皮和林产品，海路又把阿穆尔河与乌苏里江下游同朝鲜和日本列岛联系起来。狩猎、捕鱼、养畜与农耕构成通古斯诸族的混合经济。

english:
Cape Spear projects into the Atlantic from Newfoundland's Avalon Peninsula, near the entrance to St John's harbour. Portuguese navigators called it Cabo da Esperança, the Cape of Hope; the French name Cap d'Espoir later gave rise to its English name. The exposed headland was chosen for a lighthouse to guide vessels approaching the harbour. Lit in September 1836, its first lamp had previously served at Inchkeith on the coast of Scotland.

The later city of St. John's lies here.
simp_chinese:
斯皮尔角从纽芬兰的阿瓦隆半岛伸入大西洋，靠近圣约翰斯港入口。葡萄牙航海者称它为Cabo da Esperança，即希望角；法语的Cap d'Espoir后来演变成英语名称。为引导驶向港口的船只，人们选择在这处迎风的岬角建造灯塔。灯塔于1836年9月亮灯，最初使用的灯器曾在苏格兰海岸的英奇基斯岛服役。

后来的圣约翰斯即位于此地。

english: Cape Santa Maria projects from the sandy barrier islands of the Ria Formosa on the Algarve coast. The chain of islands and spits separates a shallow lagoon from the Atlantic, with channels through which tides enter and leave. Near the cape the barrier lies several kilometers from the mainland, sheltering the waterways behind it. Sand, tides and storms have continually shaped this low coastline, in marked contrast to the cliffs farther west toward Cape São Vicente.
simp_chinese: 圣玛丽角从阿尔加维海岸的福尔摩沙潟湖沙质屏障岛向海伸出。一连串岛屿和沙嘴将浅潟湖与大西洋分隔，潮水通过其间的水道进出。海角附近的屏障距大陆数公里，保护后方的水道。沙、潮汐和风暴不断塑造这片低平海岸，与更西方通往圣维森特角的峭壁形成鲜明对比。

english: The northern Somali coast faces the Gulf of Aden, with dry hills behind a narrow shore. Seasonal winds carried vessels between this coast and Arabia, while caravans brought inland goods to coastal markets. In the early sixteenth century ships trading from Berbera and Zeila sailed toward India as well as across the gulf. Their cargoes connected the Horn of Africa with a much wider maritime world.
simp_chinese: 索马里北岸面向亚丁湾，狭窄海岸后方是干燥丘陵。季节风推动船只往来于海岸与阿拉伯之间，商队则将内陆货物带到沿海市场。16世纪初，从柏培拉和泽拉出发的贸易船只既横渡海湾，也驶向印度。货物往来将非洲之角与更广阔的海洋世界相连。

sources.title: Notes on the history of Berbera.pdf

english: The waters off Tajura lie along the coast of Tripolitania, east of Tripoli. Behind this Mediterranean shore stretches the Jefara plain, a low region of coastal oases and dry country. Farther inland the land rises toward the escarpment of the Nafusa plateau. Along the western Tripolitanian coast, the oases provided places of cultivation amid a landscape whose interior was much less hospitable.
simp_chinese: 塔朱拉外海沿着的黎波里以东的的黎波里塔尼亚海岸展开。地中海岸后方是低平的杰法拉平原，沿海绿洲散布在干旱土地之间；更深入内陆，地势升向奈富塞高原的陡崖。的黎波里塔尼亚西部海岸的绿洲为耕作提供了立足之地，而远离海岸的地带则艰苦得多。

english: Cape Tamiang projects from the northeastern coast of Sumatra into the Strait of Malacca. The low cape marks a shore on the great maritime route between the Indian Ocean and the South China Sea. Along the coast between Tamiang and Deli, the Bukit Barisan mountains are visible from offshore, rising behind the lands associated with the old kingdom of Aru.
simp_chinese: 塔米昂角从苏门答腊东北岸伸入马六甲海峡。这处低平岬角位于连接印度洋与南海的重要海上航路旁。从塔米昂到德利一带的海面上，可以望见巴里桑山脉耸立在沿岸土地之后；这片海岸曾与古代阿鲁王国有关。

english: Cape Tarkhankut forms the westernmost point of Crimea, where limestone cliffs meet the Black Sea. The headland belongs to a broad peninsula of dry steppe and shallow coastal bays. In antiquity the agricultural territory of Greek Chersonese extended along the western Crimean coast toward Tarkhankut, leaving traces of settlements and fields. The projecting cape marks a turn for ships following the coast between the northern and southern Black Sea.
simp_chinese: 塔尔汉库特角是克里米亚最西端，石灰岩悬崖在此迎向黑海。海角属于一片广阔半岛，内陆为干燥草原，岸边分布浅湾。古代希腊城邦赫尔松尼苏斯的农业领地沿克里米亚西岸延伸至塔尔汉库特，留下聚落和田地的痕迹。突出的海角也是船只沿黑海南北海岸航行时的转折地标。

english: Cape Tawinis stands at the eastern approach to the Gulf of Sirte, the broad indentation in the northern coast of Libya. The gulf stretches westward toward Cape Misurata, its shores enclosing a great sweep of Mediterranean water. Known to ancient writers as the Greater Syrtis, it was feared for its sandbanks and its exposure to northerly winds. Strabo advised sailors to keep their distance from the coast, lest the wind drive them into the dangerous shallows.
simp_chinese: 塔维尼斯角位于苏尔特湾的东侧入口。这座宽阔海湾深深凹入利比亚北岸，向西延伸至米苏拉塔角，两侧岸线环抱着大片地中海水域。古代作者称之为大锡尔提斯，海湾中的沙洲与迎面吹来的北风令水手畏惧。斯特拉波劝告航海者远离岸边，以免被风吹入危险的浅水。

english: Cape Three Forks is a mountainous promontory thrusting into the Alboran Sea from northeastern Morocco. Its rugged heights form a conspicuous landmark near the port of Melilla. Phoenicians and Carthaginians knew the cape as Rusadir, a name shared with the neighbouring port, while Roman geographers called it Metagonites. South of the peninsula, the Marinid rulers built the castle of Tazouda, overlooking the country behind the maritime headland.
simp_chinese: 三叉角是一座多山的岬角，从摩洛哥东北部伸入阿尔沃兰海。崎岖高地在梅利利亚港附近形成醒目的海上地标。腓尼基人和迦太基人称它为鲁萨迪尔，邻近港口也使用过这个名字；罗马地理学家则称其为梅塔戈尼特斯角。半岛南方，马林王朝统治者修筑了塔祖达城堡，俯瞰海岬后方的土地。

english:
