Kilmeaden lies along the old road west of Waterford, with the village, civil parish and nearby townland sharing the name. Its position in low hills and wooded river country gave the district waterpower and pasture, while the road kept it tied to Waterford city and the wider route toward Carrick-on-Suir. Kilmeaden Castle first belonged to Sir Walter de la Haye, a leading figure in Irish government from about 1270 to 1308, and passed to the le Poer family in the fourteenth century.

Cromwellian forces destroyed the castle around 1650. Its lands were granted to the Ottringtons and later passed by inheritance to the family of Viscount Doneraile. Industry grew beside the River Dawn at Fairbrook. William Phair founded the mill that took his name, and 140 men, women and children worked there by 1824.

The Mount Congreve estate and farms added further uses to the valley. Castle, estate and mill each concentrated wealth and authority in the same small district, leaving ruins, pathways and buildings that reveal how rural production changed over time.
simp_chinese:
基尔米登沿着沃特福德以西的旧道路展开，村庄、民政教区和附近镇地共用这个名字。低丘、树林与河谷为当地提供水力与牧场，道路则把它同沃特福德城以及通往卡里克苏尔的路线相连。基尔米登城堡最初属于沃尔特·德拉海爵士，他在约1270年至1308年间是爱尔兰政府的重要人物；十四世纪，城堡转入勒波尔家族。

约1650年，克伦威尔军队将其摧毁。城堡土地先授予奥特林顿家族，后经继承传给多纳莱尔子爵家族。道恩河畔的费尔布鲁克逐渐发展工业。威廉·费尔创建了以自己命名的磨坊，到1824年已有男女和儿童共一百四十人在此劳动。

芒特康格里夫庄园和农场进一步丰富了河谷的用途。城堡、庄园与磨坊都把财富和权力集中在这片狭小地区，留下的废墟、道路和建筑呈现出乡村生产方式的长期变化。

english:
Carrickfergus stands on the northern shore of Belfast Lough, dominated by the great castle raised by the Anglo-Norman lord John de Courcy. Its walls protected a port and garrison that gave English rulers a foothold in Ulster, while the sheltered lough linked the town to routes across the Irish Sea.

In 1597 the castle's governor, Sir John Chichester, was defeated outside the town by James MacSorley MacDonnell's forces. During the Williamite war Carrickfergus became a landing place for William III, who came ashore here on 14 June 1690 before advancing south. The castle saw another attack in 1760, when a French force briefly captured it during the Seven Years' War. Its long service reflects the strategic value of the harbour and the coast it commanded.
simp_chinese:
卡里克弗格斯位于贝尔法斯特湾北岸，盎格鲁—诺曼领主约翰·德库尔西建造的宏大城堡俯瞰城镇。城墙保护港口和驻军，为英格兰统治者在阿尔斯特提供立足点；避风海湾则将城镇与横渡爱尔兰海的航路连接起来。

1597年，城堡总督约翰·奇切斯特爵士在城外被詹姆斯·麦克索利·麦克唐纳的军队击败。威廉派战争中，威廉三世于1690年6月14日在此登陆，随后向南进军。1760年七年战争期间，法国军队又短暂攻占城堡。堡垒长期发挥的作用，反映出港口及其控制的海岸具有战略价值。

english: Inniskeen lies beside the River Fane in the countryside of southern Monaghan. Its name recalls an island, and the remains of a round tower mark the site of a monastery associated with Saint Daig. The monastery appears in the annals in the seventh century, while a later Augustinian house was connected to the abbey at Louth. The church on the old site had fallen into ruin by 1622, but the burial ground and tower preserved the memory of a religious settlement that had served this district for centuries.
simp_chinese: 因尼斯金位于莫纳亨南部乡间的费恩河畔。地名让人想起一座岛屿，圆塔遗迹标示着与圣戴格有关的修道院旧址。七世纪的编年史已记载这座修院，后来一处奥斯定会机构与劳斯修院相联系。到1622年，旧址上的教堂已成废墟，但墓地和圆塔仍保留着这处服务当地数百年的宗教聚落的记忆。

english: Carrión de los Condes stands on the pilgrimage road across the plains of Tierra de Campos. Its monastery of San Zoilo received the relics of the martyr from Córdoba in the eleventh century and became an important religious and political centre, welcoming pilgrims and royal visitors. After a long decline, the monastery joined the Benedictine congregation of Valladolid in the fifteenth century. Its old cloister was replaced by an elaborate new one, carved to celebrate the history and importance of the order.
simp_chinese: 卡里翁德洛斯孔德斯坐落在横穿坎波斯平原的朝圣路上。十一世纪，圣索伊洛修道院迎来从科尔多瓦运来的殉道者圣髑，成为重要的宗教与政治中心，接待朝圣者和王室访客。经历长期衰落后，修道院于十五世纪加入巴利亚多利德的本笃会团体。旧回廊被精美的新回廊取代，石雕颂扬了修会的历史和地位。

english:
Founded around 227 BC by the Carthaginian general Hasdrubal as #italic Qart Ḥadašt#!, the city the Romans renamed #italic Carthago Nova#! upon one of the finest natural harbors of the Mediterranean. It grew rich on its silver mines and hosted a great naval arsenal, famously stormed by Scipio Africanus in 209 BC during the war against Carthage. Its bishopric was among the oldest in Hispania, but the long centuries of decline and the Muslim conquest reduced the once-great port to a shadow of its ancient self. Retaken for Castile by the infante Alfonso in 1245 and granted its restored see, Cartagena by the early 14th century was a modest, but strategically vital harbor on the frontier of the Castilian realm, its magnificent bay still sheltering the fleets that plied the southern coast.

For a long time the town stayed small, and even the bishop's seat that Castile had restored moved away to Murcia. Its bay mattered again once the crown looked across the sea: a fleet sailed from here for the war in Naples in 1503, and in 1509 Cardinal Cisneros fitted out his expedition against Oran in the harbour. The great change came under the Bourbons. After 1726 Philip V divided the Spanish coast into three naval departments, each with its own arsenal, and made Cartagena the head of the Mediterranean one. From 1732 the engineer Sebastián Feringán dug a great basin out of the shore and lined it with dry docks, workshops and barracks, works that took fifty years to finish. By the end of the 18th century the arsenal was the largest industrial complex on the whole Mediterranean coast of Spain, and its yards had launched 21 ships of the line and 17 frigates.
simp_chinese:
卡塔赫纳由迦太基将军哈斯德鲁巴在约公元前227年建立，名为#italic 卡尔特·哈达什特#!，位于地中海最优良的天然港口之一上，罗马人将其更名为#italic 新迦太基#!。该城凭借其腹地的银矿繁荣富裕，并拥有一座大型海军军械库。公元前209年，在对抗迦太基的战争中，大西庇阿曾攻陷此城，名噪一时。其主教区是西班牙最古老的教区之一，但长达数世纪的衰落和穆斯林征服，使这座曾经的伟大港口沦为古时辉煌的残影。1245年，该城被卡斯蒂利亚王子阿方索收复，其教区得以恢复。至14世纪初，卡塔赫纳仍是卡斯蒂利亚王国边疆上一个规模不大但战略意义至关重要的港口，其壮丽的海湾仍庇护着沿南部海岸航行的舰队。

此后很长一段时间里，卡塔赫纳一直是座小城，连卡斯蒂利亚恢复的主教座也迁去了穆尔西亚。直到王室把目光投向海外，这处海湾才重新受到重视：1503年，一支舰队从这里启航，参加那不勒斯的战争；1509年，枢机主教西斯内罗斯在港内装备远征奥兰的舰队。真正的转折出现在波旁王朝。1726年后，腓力五世把西班牙海岸划为三个海军辖区，各设一座军港，卡塔赫纳成了地中海辖区的首府。1732年起，工程师塞瓦斯蒂安·费林甘在海岸上挖出一座巨大的港池，四周修起干船坞、工场和营房，工程前后用了五十年。到18世纪末，这座军港已是西班牙整个地中海沿岸最大的工业设施，船台上已造出21艘战列舰和17艘护卫舰。

english:
Cartagena Bay cuts into Colombia’s Caribbean coast, its sheltered waters approached through channels between islands and peninsulas. The city of Cartagena became a vital Spanish port, linking the mainland with the fleets that sailed through the West Indies. Its strategic position and wealth made it a target for rival powers, and an extensive system of walls, batteries and forts grew around the city and the bay.

The defences guarded both the inner harbour and its approaches. At Bocachica, the southwestern entrance, successive fortifications commanded the channel through which ships entered. The great fortress of San Felipe de Barajas rose on a hill east of the city. Built and strengthened over generations, these works protected a port central to Spanish commerce and imperial rivalry in the Caribbean.
simp_chinese:
卡塔赫纳湾深入哥伦比亚加勒比海岸，船只穿过岛屿与半岛之间的水道进入受庇护的港湾。卡塔赫纳城成为西班牙的重要港口，将大陆与航行于西印度群岛的船队连接起来。战略位置和财富使它成为对手攻击的目标，城市与海湾周围逐渐形成庞大的城墙、炮台和堡垒体系。

防御工事守卫内港及其入口。西南方的博卡奇卡水道有数代修筑的堡垒控制船只进出；城东山丘上则耸立着圣费利佩德巴拉哈斯大堡垒。这些工程历经多代建造和加固，保护着西班牙贸易与加勒比帝国争夺中的关键港口。

english: The Carteret Islands are a low coral atoll northeast of Bougainville, with small islets strung along a reef enclosing a lagoon. Its people lived by the sea and cultivated the limited land of the islets. In 1767 Philip Carteret encountered the islands during the voyage of HMS Swallow; the English name of the group commemorates him, while the islands also bear the local name Kilinailau.
simp_chinese: 卡特雷特群岛是布干维尔东北方的一座低矮珊瑚环礁，小岛散布在围绕潟湖的礁缘上。岛民依海为生，并耕种岛上有限的土地。1767年，菲利普·卡特雷特乘“燕子”号航行时遇见这些岛屿；群岛的英文名称纪念了他，当地也称其为基利奈劳。

english: Along the northern shore of the St. Lawrence, seven islands shelter the deep bay of Sept-Îles from the gulf. Jacques Cartier recorded the islands during his voyage in 1535, while the Innu had long gathered on this coast. A fur-trading post was established beside the bay in the seventeenth century, near a sheltered river mouth. Offshore, the broad water separates the wooded mainland from Anticosti Island and the routes into the gulf.
simp_chinese: 圣劳伦斯河北岸，七座岛屿在海湾与外海之间为七岛湾提供屏障。雅克·卡蒂埃在1535年的航行中记下这些岛屿，因努人则早已在此岸聚集。十七世纪，湾边避风的河口附近建立了毛皮商站。岸外宽阔的水面将林木覆盖的大陆与安蒂科斯蒂岛分开，船只可从这里驶入圣劳伦斯湾。

english: The Caru is part of the Pindaré river country in the eastern Amazon, a landscape of forest and streams in Maranhão. The region has been home to Indigenous peoples including the Awá-Guajá and Guajajara. Forest plants, including the babaçu palm, have provided food and materials, while the rivers and their tributaries run northward through the lowlands toward the coast.
simp_chinese: 卡鲁属于亚马孙东部马拉尼昂的平达雷河地区，这里遍布森林与溪流，是阿瓦－瓜雅和瓜雅雅拉等原住民族的家园。森林植物，包括巴巴苏棕榈，提供食物和材料；河流及支流向北穿过低地，流向海岸。

english:
Carucairi, or Karukera, is an Indigenous name for Guadeloupe, an island group in the Lesser Antilles. The mountainous western island and lower eastern island are separated by a narrow channel. Rivers, forests and coastal waters supported the Indigenous inhabitants who knew it as the island of beautiful waters.

Columbus reached Guadeloupe in 1493, but French colonists did not establish a lasting settlement until 1635. Sugar and other plantation crops expanded through the forced labor of enslaved Africans brought across the Atlantic to the colony. During the French Revolution, Britain captured the island in 1794; French republican forces returned and publicly proclaimed the abolition of slavery. Freedom was then reversed when French authorities restored slavery in 1802, after fierce local armed resistance on the island.

The later city of Basse-Terre lies here.
simp_chinese:
卡鲁凯里，即卡鲁凯拉，是小安的列斯群岛瓜德罗普的原住民名称。西部多山岛屿与东部较低岛屿之间隔着狭窄水道。河流、森林与沿海水域养育着原住民，他们称这里为“美丽水域之岛”。

哥伦布于1493年抵达瓜德罗普，但法国殖民者直到1635年才建立持久聚落。甘蔗等种植园作物不断扩展，依靠被迫横渡大西洋来到殖民地的非洲奴隶劳动。法国大革命期间，英国于1794年夺取岛屿；法国共和派返回后宣布废除奴隶制。1802年法国当局在岛上激烈抵抗后恢复奴隶制，自由再次被剥夺。

后来的巴斯特尔即位于此地。

english:
Casale stands on the southern bank of the Po at the foot of the hills of Montferrat. A settlement grew here around the church of Saint Evasius, and the town became an important centre of trade. In the fifteenth century it served as the capital of the marquises of Montferrat of the Palaiologos family.

Casale had come under the marquises in 1292, though the Visconti of Milan held the town from 1370 to 1404. In 1536 it passed to the Gonzaga of Mantua, who built strong fortifications and a citadel. Its position on the Po made the town a valuable frontier fortress during the wars of the seventeenth century, including the bitter War of the Mantuan Succession, when it endured sieges by rival armies.
simp_chinese:
卡萨莱坐落在波河南岸、蒙费拉托丘陵脚下。聚落围绕圣埃瓦西奥教堂发展，城镇后来成为重要的贸易中心。十五世纪，它是巴列奥略家族蒙费拉托侯爵的首都。

卡萨莱于1292年归入侯爵统治，但维斯孔蒂家族曾于1370年至1404年控制此城。1536年，它转入曼图亚的贡扎加家族手中，家族修建了坚固防线和城堡。波河畔的位置使城镇在十七世纪战争中成为重要要塞；曼图亚王位继承战争期间，它遭到敌对军队围攻。

english:
Casalmaggiore stands beside the Po in the Cremona plain, where the river shifts across broad gravel bars and floodplain fields. Bronze Age remains show occupation long before written records. The name probably derives from a Roman military camp, Castra Majora.

Around the year 1000 a fortified castle belonged to the House of Este. Its position gave access to boats travelling the Po and roads across the Cremona plain. In the fifteenth century Casalmaggiore came under Venice, entering a network of river commerce, fortifications and territorial defense between Milan and the Venetian mainland.

An imperial decree recognized the town as a city in 1754, recording an older urban role. Markets handled grain, cheese, hemp and river transport, while floods repeatedly changed the banks. The town’s identity comes from the Po crossing and the strategic river corridor of Lombardy.
simp_chinese:
卡萨尔马焦雷位于克雷莫纳平原波河畔，河流在大片砾石洲与洪泛田之间移动。青铜时代遗存显示文字记录以前已有人居住。名称可能来自罗马军营“卡斯特拉马约拉”。

约1000年，一座设防城堡属于埃斯特家族。其位置控制波河船只和穿越克雷莫纳平原的道路。十五世纪，卡萨尔马焦雷归入威尼斯，加入米兰与威尼斯属地之间的河运、防御和领土防卫网络。

1754年，帝国敕令承认其城市地位，只是确认既有城市作用。市场交易谷物、奶酪、大麻并依赖河运，洪水不断改变河岸。城镇身份来自波河渡口及伦巴第战略河廊。

english:
The Casamance River flows west through a landscape of tidal channels, mangroves and cultivated land before reaching the Atlantic. Its tributaries, including the Soungrougrou, carry the tides far inland. Jola communities and their neighbours cultivated rice in this watery country, while Mandinka influence extended into the middle and upper river region. In 1645 Portuguese traders established a permanent post at Ziguinchor after building connections farther south along the Cacheu River.

The later city of Ziguinchor lies here.
simp_chinese:
卡萨芒斯河向西流过潮汐水道、红树林与耕地交织的地区，最终注入大西洋。松格鲁格鲁河等支流将潮汐带入内陆深处。若拉人及其邻居在这片水乡种植稻米，曼丁卡人的影响则延伸至河流中上游。1645年，葡萄牙商人在南方卡谢乌河建立联系后，于济金绍设立永久商站。

后来的济金绍尔即位于此地。

english:
Cascapédia lies on the Gaspé coast of Quebec, where the Cascapédia River empties into the Cascapédia Bay, a small bay of the Baie des Chaleurs. The river rises in the Chic-Choc Mountains and runs about 120 kilometres to the sea through forest, and it has long been recognised as one of Quebec’s richest Atlantic salmon rivers. In 1835 the surveyor Joseph Hamel noted the abundance of fish in it, including trout, salmon and whitefish.

This is Mi’kmaq country, part of the district of Gespe’gewa’gi. The river’s name comes from the Mi’kmaq gesgapegiag, usually explained as the place where the river widens or a broad river with a strong current, and a Mi’kmaq summer community stood on the coast. It first appears on Franquelin’s map of 1686 as Kichkabeguiak. By at least 1784 Mi’kmaq families had begun to settle permanently along the river, and from an early period they also made maple sugar on Horse Island. Rivers, forests and the bay supplied fish, game and the means of travel for the people who lived here before and after European contact.
simp_chinese:
卡斯卡佩迪亚位于魁北克的加斯佩海岸，卡斯卡佩迪亚河在这里注入卡斯卡佩迪亚湾，那是沙勒尔湾中的一处小海湾。这条河发源于奇克—肖克山脉，穿过森林流约一百二十公里入海，长期被公认为魁北克最富饶的大西洋鲑鱼河之一。1835年，测量员约瑟夫·阿梅尔记录了河中鳟鱼、鲑鱼和白鲑的丰富。

这里是米克马克人的土地，属于加斯佩吉瓦吉地区。河名来自米克马克语gesgapegiag，通常解释为河流变宽之处，或水流强劲的宽阔大河，沿岸曾有米克马克人的夏季社区。1686年，弗朗克兰的地图上首次出现这个名字，写作Kichkabeguiak。至迟到1784年，米克马克家庭已开始在河边永久定居，他们很早就在霍斯岛上制作枫糖。河流、森林和海湾为欧洲人到来前后生活在这里的人们提供了鱼类、猎物和出行通道。

english:
Casco Bay opens onto the Gulf of Maine, its indented shores sheltered by a multitude of islands. The Aucocisco lived near the Presumpscot River on the western side of the bay, while the Pejepscot occupied its eastern shores and the Androscoggin valley. Shell middens and other remains on the islands bear witness to much older visits by Indigenous people.

In 1623 the English explorer Christopher Levett visited the bay and met Abenaki leaders before choosing an island for a settlement. He had a stone house built and left a small party there when he returned to England; their subsequent fate is unknown. Other English settlers established themselves on the mainland in the following years, including George Cleeve and Richard Tucker, who began a fur trade at Casco Neck.
simp_chinese:
卡斯柯湾向缅因湾敞开，众多岛屿掩护着曲折的海岸。奥科西斯科人居住在海湾西侧的普雷桑普斯科特河附近，佩杰普斯科特人则生活在东岸及北方的安德罗斯科金河谷。岛上的贝丘与其他遗存，见证了原住民在更久远的年代便曾到访此地。

1623年，英国探险者克里斯托弗·莱维特来到海湾，与阿贝纳基人的首领会面后选定一座岛屿建立定居点。他命人建起石屋，返回英国时留下了一小群人；他们此后的命运并不为人所知。随后数年，其他英国移民来到大陆定居，其中乔治·克利夫和理查德·塔克在卡斯柯颈地开展了毛皮贸易。

english: Casco Bay opens onto the Gulf of Maine, its shore broken by many islands, ledges and river mouths. Abenaki communities lived around the bay, including the Aucocisco near the Presumpscot and the Pejepscot farther east. Shell middens on the islands bear witness to generations of visits and encampments. French explorers Samuel de Champlain and Pierre Dugua de Mons explored the bay in 1605, and English merchant Christopher Levett attempted a settlement on one of its islands in the 1620s.
simp_chinese: 卡斯柯湾朝缅因湾敞开，海岸被众多岛屿、礁石和河口分割。阿贝纳基社群居住在海湾周围，包括普雷桑普斯科特河附近的奥科科西斯科人，以及更东面的佩杰普斯科特人。岛上的贝壳堆见证了人们世代到访和扎营。1605年，法国探险者萨缪尔·德·尚普兰和皮埃尔·迪居阿·德·蒙探索此湾；1620年代，英国商人克里斯托弗·莱维特又试图在岛上建立聚落。

english:
Caserta lies on the plain north of Naples, beneath the hills of Campania. A medieval settlement grew on the heights above the plain, but the town's most imposing landmark arose below: a royal palace and garden laid out for the Bourbon kings. Its great façades and long axis of gardens transformed the landscape into a setting for the court.

Charles of Bourbon commissioned Luigi Vanvitelli to design the palace, and construction began in 1752. The ambitious complex included a park, waterworks and the silk establishment of San Leucio. Thousands of workers laboured on the palace, while decoration of the royal apartments continued into the nineteenth century. Caserta expressed the king's ambition to build a residence worthy of the great courts of Europe.
simp_chinese:
卡塞塔位于那不勒斯以北的平原，背靠坎帕尼亚丘陵。中世纪聚落建在平原上方的高地，最雄伟的建筑后来却在下方兴起：波旁国王的王宫与花园。宏大的立面和花园长轴改变了地貌，为宫廷提供壮丽的场所。

波旁的查理委托路易吉·万维泰利设计王宫，工程于1752年开始。宏大建筑群包括园林、供水设施和圣莱乌乔丝绸工场。数千名工人参与施工，王室居室的装饰一直持续到十九世纪。卡塞塔体现了国王营建足以与欧洲大宫廷匹敌的居所的抱负。

english:
The Rock of Cashel rises sharply above the plains of Tipperary, crowned by a cathedral, round tower and chapel. Once a seat of the kings of Munster, the rock became a great ecclesiastical centre after its gift to the church in the twelfth century. Cormac's Chapel and the Gothic cathedral stand among the buildings raised on its summit. The town below grew around this remarkable stronghold of religious authority.

In 1647, during the wars of the Irish Confederation, Parliamentarian forces under Lord Inchiquin attacked Cashel. The cathedral was sacked and many who had taken refuge on the rock were killed. The buildings survived the assault, but the violence marked a profound rupture in the history of a place long associated with the kings and archbishops of Munster.
simp_chinese:
卡舍尔岩从蒂珀雷里平原陡然升起，山顶有座堂、圆塔和礼拜堂。这里曾是芒斯特国王的驻地，十二世纪献给教会后成为重要宗教中心。山顶建筑包括科马克礼拜堂和哥特式座堂，下方城镇围绕这一醒目的教会权威据点发展。

1647年爱尔兰联盟战争期间，因奇昆勋爵率议会派军队进攻卡舍尔。座堂遭洗劫，许多在岩上避难的人被杀。建筑在袭击中留存，但这场暴力深刻改变了这处长期与芒斯特国王及大主教相联系的地方。

english: Casiguran lies on the Pacific coast of eastern Luzon, where the Sierra Madre rises behind the shore. Dumagat-Agta communities inhabited its rivers and forests before Spanish missionaries arrived. In 1609 Franciscans established a mission here and at neighbouring Baler, gathering people into settlements for conversion. Shortages of missionaries led the Augustinians and Recollects to take responsibility for the district in 1658; the Franciscans returned in 1703. The mountains made communication with the plains to the west difficult.
simp_chinese: 卡西古兰位于吕宋东部太平洋海岸，马德雷山脉耸立在海岸背后。西班牙传教士到来之前，杜马加特—阿格塔社群居住在当地河流与森林之间。1609年，方济各会在这里及邻近的巴莱尔建立传教站，将居民集中到聚落中传教。由于人手不足，奥思定会和隐修士于1658年接管该地区；方济各会于1703年返回。山脉使这里与西部平原的交通困难。

english: Casiste was a town recorded by the chroniclers of Hernando de Soto's expedition as it travelled through the Alabama interior in 1540. It lay on a stream along the route between Talisi and the country of the chief Tuskaloosa. The name has been connected with Kasihta, a community that later moved east to the Chattahoochee valley. There Kasihta became one of the towns of the Creek confederacy, whose constituent communities retained their own leaders and identities.
simp_chinese: 卡西斯泰是埃尔南多·德·索托远征队于1540年穿越阿拉巴马内陆时记下的一座城镇。它位于一条河流旁，处在塔利西与首领塔斯卡卢萨领地之间的路线上。这个名字与卡西塔社群有关，后者后来东迁至查塔胡奇河谷。卡西塔在那里成为克里克联盟的城镇之一，联盟中的各社群仍保有自己的领袖和身份。

english:
Čáslav stands beside the Brslenka stream in the central Bohemian plain. Its predecessor was the fortified settlement of Hrádek, founded in the ninth century and later a Přemyslid administrative centre. Around 1250 King Ottokar II founded a royal town beside it, laid out around a broad square. A Jewish community was established by the fourteenth century, though its members were expelled in the next century.

In 1421 the Bohemian parliament met at Čáslav and elected a new Hussite government. Great fires damaged the town in 1452 and 1522, and Swedish troops devastated and burned it in 1639 and 1642 during the Thirty Years' War. Čáslav recovered from these disasters and became the administrative centre of a region in 1715, more than a century after the devastating fires.
simp_chinese:
恰斯拉夫位于波希米亚中部平原的布尔斯伦卡溪畔。它的前身是九世纪建立的赫拉德克设防聚落，后来成为普热美斯尔王朝的行政中心。约1250年，奥托卡二世国王在旁边创建王室城镇，城镇围绕宽阔广场布局。十四世纪当地已有犹太社群，但其成员在下一个世纪被驱逐。

1421年，波希米亚议会在恰斯拉夫召开，选出胡斯派政府。1452年和1522年的大火严重破坏城镇；三十年战争中，瑞典军队又于1639年和1642年焚掠此地。恰斯拉夫在灾难后恢复，1715年成为地区中心。

english:
Caspe lies in the dry Ebro lowland of Aragon, beside the Guadalope near its meeting with the Ebro. The site combines a river crossing, irrigated fields and routes toward Zaragoza, Catalonia and Valencia. Its Andalusi name, recorded as Qsp or Qasp, may refer to a fortified place; another explanation links it to an older word for oak.

By the Middle Ages, Caspe had become a small Christian town at a contested frontier. The Order of Saint John held the town and its castle, organizing defence, irrigation and settlement in the surrounding dry country. The Compromise of Caspe in 1412 chose Ferdinand of Antequera as king of Aragon, making the town briefly a centre of Iberian politics. Its delegates met amid rival claims to the crown.

After the medieval union of Aragon and Castile, Caspe remained a market for grain, olives, wool and livestock. The Ebro and Guadalope supplied water but could also flood the low fields. Roads and ferries made the town a local hinge between the Aragonese interior and the Mediterranean coast, while the name and castle preserved its frontier role.
simp_chinese:
卡斯佩位于阿拉贡干旱的埃布罗低地，临瓜达洛佩河，靠近它与埃布罗河交汇处。河流渡口、灌溉田地以及通往萨拉戈萨、加泰罗尼亚与瓦伦西亚的道路在此结合。安达卢斯文献把它写作“Qsp”或“Qasp”，可能指设防地点，也有人追溯到更早的橡树一词。

中世纪时，卡斯佩成为边界争夺中的基督教小城。圣约翰骑士团掌握城镇与城堡，组织周围旱地的防御、灌溉和定居。1412年“卡斯佩妥协”在这里推选安特克拉的斐迪南为阿拉贡国王，使小城短暂成为伊比利亚政治中心，代表们在王位竞争者之间集会。

阿拉贡与卡斯蒂利亚联合以后，卡斯佩仍是谷物、橄榄、羊毛和牲畜市场。埃布罗河与瓜达洛佩河提供水源，也会淹没低田。道路和渡船使城镇成为阿拉贡内陆与地中海沿岸之间的地方枢纽，名称和城堡则保存着边疆记忆。

english: At the southeastern corner of the Caspian, the long sandy spit of Miankaleh almost encloses the shallow Gulf of Gorgan, also called Astarabad Bay. Streams descend from the wooded slopes of the Alborz to the lagoon, while the country east of it becomes drier towards the Gorgan steppe. Near the end of the spit lie the islands of Ashuradeh, at the entrance to the bay.
simp_chinese: 在里海东南角，狭长的米安卡莱沙嘴几乎环抱了浅浅的戈尔甘湾，这片水域也称阿斯塔拉巴德湾。溪流从厄尔布尔士山脉林木茂盛的山坡流向潟湖，湾东的地势则逐渐干燥，过渡到戈尔甘草原。沙嘴尽头附近是阿舒拉德岛屿，位于海湾入口处。

english: Along the western Caspian, the coastal route passes between the sea and the mountains of the Caucasus. Derbent guarded its narrowest passage: the city's great defensive walls reached from the high ground down to the shore and out into the water. Maritime traffic connected Derbent with Baku, Shirvan and Astrakhan, forming part of the network of routes that joined the Volga basin to the markets of the south.
simp_chinese: 里海西岸的道路穿行于海水与高加索山脉之间。杰尔宾特扼守最狭窄的通道，城中的巨大防御墙从高地延伸到海岸，甚至伸入水中。海上航运将杰尔宾特与巴库、希尔凡和阿斯特拉罕联系起来，成为连接伏尔加河流域与南方市场的交通网络的一部分。

english: The sea approaches the mountain wall of the Caucasus at Derbent, leaving a narrow strip of coast that has long been guarded by fortifications. The city's walls once extended into the Caspian itself, controlling passage by water as well as land. Peter the Great captured Derbent during his Persian campaign in 1722, but Russia returned it to Persia under the treaty of Ganja in 1735.
simp_chinese: 在杰尔宾特，里海逼近高加索的山墙，海与山之间只留下狭窄的沿岸通道，长期受到要塞守卫。城墙曾延伸至海水之中，控制陆路与水路的通行。彼得大帝在1722年远征波斯时攻占杰尔宾特，俄国又依据1735年的甘贾条约将其归还波斯。

english: The western Caspian shore runs below the mountains of Dagestan, with a narrow coastal plain linking the country around Tarki to Derbent and lands farther south. This coast formed part of the Volga–Caspian trade network, in which ships and overland caravans connected northern markets with Shirvan and Persia. Beyond the coastal strip the mountains rise sharply, while the middle Caspian opens eastwards.
simp_chinese: 里海西岸沿达吉斯坦群山脚下延伸，狭窄的沿海平原将塔尔基附近地区与南面的杰尔宾特及更远的土地连接起来。这片海岸属于伏尔加河－里海贸易网络，船只与陆上商队将北方市场同希尔凡和波斯相连。海岸平原之外，山地陡然升高；向东则是开阔的里海中部水域。

english: The Terek flows from the Caucasus to the western Caspian, spreading into a broad, marshy delta below Kizlyar. Nearby the low sandy Agrakhan peninsula reaches into the sea and shelters a bay along the delta's southeastern edge. River channels, wetlands and shallow coastal waters make this a changing landscape, where the mountain river deposits its burden before entering the enclosed sea.
simp_chinese: 捷列克河从高加索流向里海西岸，在基兹利亚尔下游展开为宽阔的沼泽三角洲。附近低平的阿格拉汉沙质半岛伸入海中，在三角洲东南缘围出一片海湾。河道、湿地与沿岸浅水共同构成多变的景观，山间河流在汇入内陆海之前于此沉积泥沙。

english: The northwestern Caspian receives waters from the Volga and the Terek, whose channels spread across low delta lands before reaching the sea. The Terek descends from the Caucasus, while the Volga opens a route far north into Russia. Astrakhan on the lower Volga became a centre of Caspian commerce; from there ships sailed south towards the Persian coast and across to Mangyshlak.
simp_chinese: 里海西北部接纳伏尔加河与捷列克河的河水，两条大河在入海前都穿过低平三角洲上的众多水道。捷列克河源出高加索，伏尔加河则开辟了深入俄罗斯北方的通道。伏尔加河下游的阿斯特拉罕成为里海贸易中心，船只从那里南下波斯海岸，也横渡至曼格什拉克。

english: At the northern end of the Caspian, the Volga divides into channels and islands before reaching the shallow sea. Its fresh water makes these northern reaches less salty than the basins farther south. Astrakhan, on the lower river, became a centre of maritime trade linking the Volga with Persia and the eastern shore. Boats leaving its delta had to make their way through a landscape of shoals and changing channels.
simp_chinese: 在里海北端，伏尔加河分成众多水道，环绕岛屿流入浅海。河流带来的淡水使北部海区的盐度低于南方的海盆。下游的阿斯特拉罕成为海上贸易中心，连接伏尔加河、波斯和东岸。从三角洲出发的船只须穿过浅滩与不断变化的水道。

english: The northern Caspian is a broad but remarkably shallow sea, fed by the Volga and Ural rivers. Sandbanks and reed beds fringe its low shores, and its waters are less saline than those farther south. In winter ice forms across much of the northern basin, providing a breeding ground for the Caspian seal, the only marine mammal native to this enclosed sea.
simp_chinese: 里海北部水面宽广，却极为浅薄，伏尔加河和乌拉尔河的水流入这里。低平的海岸边有沙洲与芦苇丛，海水盐度比南方低。冬季，北部海盆的大部分水面结冰，为里海海豹提供繁殖地；这种海豹是这片内陆海特有的唯一海生哺乳动物。

english: Between the mouths of the Volga and Ural, the northern Caspian spreads across a shallow basin edged by low, shifting shores. The great rivers enter through networks of channels and small islands, their fresh water softening the salinity of the sea. In winter these waters freeze, and Caspian seals gather on the ice to breed. In warmer seasons the seals disperse towards islands and feeding grounds farther south.
simp_chinese: 在伏尔加河与乌拉尔河河口之间，里海北部铺展为一片浅水海盆，岸线低平而多变。大河穿过水道与小岛交织的三角洲入海，淡水降低了海水的盐度。冬季这里结冰，里海海豹聚集在冰面上繁殖；天气转暖后，海豹散往岛屿和更南方的觅食地。

english: West of the Ural mouth, the northern Caspian spreads across an exceptionally shallow basin. In winter, ice forms over the sea and moving floes can scour furrows in the seabed beneath them. Winds drive the ice across the open water, while the low steppe shore to the north offers little shelter from the cold.
simp_chinese: 乌拉尔河口以西，北里海铺展在一片极浅的盆地中。冬季海面结冰，移动的浮冰甚至能在下方海床上刮出沟痕。风推动冰块穿过开阔水面，北面的低平草原海岸几乎无法遮挡寒冷。

english: At the northern edge of the Caspian, the Ural divides into channels before reaching a shallow coastal sea. The Peshnoy islands lie near its mouth, among low shores shaped by river deposits and changing water levels. Sturgeon travel between the Caspian and the Ural to spawn, making the river mouth an important passage between fresh and brackish waters.
simp_chinese: 里海北缘的乌拉尔河分出多条水道，流入浅浅的沿岸海域。佩什诺伊群岛位于河口附近，低平海岸受到河流沉积物和水位变化的塑造。鲟鱼往返于里海与乌拉尔河之间产卵，河口因此是淡水与微咸海水之间的重要通道。

english: The Mazandaran coast lies between the Caspian and the green northern slopes of the Alborz. At the mouth of the Babol River stood Mashhad-e Sar, a settlement that grew around a shrine and became a busy port from the mid-eighteenth century. Boats connected it with the inland town of Barforush. Mazandaran was also one of the Caspian provinces that supplied raw silk to Safavid trade.
simp_chinese: 马赞德兰海岸位于里海与厄尔布尔士山脉苍翠的北坡之间。巴博勒河口有马什哈德萨尔，聚落围绕一座圣陵兴起，从十八世纪中叶开始成为繁忙港口。船只将它与内陆的巴尔福鲁什城连接起来。马赞德兰也是向萨法维王朝贸易提供生丝的里海沿岸诸省之一。

english: The northeastern shore of the Caspian borders a dry country of steppe and desert. The Emba flows southwest across this region towards the sea, though its lower course breaks into shallow lakes and marshes. Offshore, the northern basin is exceptionally shallow and is affected by changing water levels. In winter the sea can freeze, in sharp contrast to the deeper and milder southern Caspian.
simp_chinese: 里海东北岸毗邻干燥的草原与沙漠。恩巴河穿过这片地区向西南流向里海，但下游分散为浅湖和沼泽。岸外北部海盆极浅，水位变化会影响海岸与浅滩。冬季这里的水面可能结冰，与更深、气候较温和的里海南部形成鲜明对照。

english: The low Buzachi peninsula projects into the northeastern Caspian south of the Ural delta. Around it the sea is shallow, its shores broken by bays, sandy spits and small islands. Caspian seals frequent these waters during their seasonal movements, feeding and resting along the northeastern coast. In winter ice spreads across the northern basin, while farther south the sea deepens beyond the Mangyshlak peninsula.
simp_chinese: 低平的布扎奇半岛从乌拉尔河三角洲以南伸入里海东北部。周围海水浅薄，海湾、沙嘴与小岛使海岸曲折。里海海豹在季节性迁徙时来到东北海岸，在这里觅食和休息。冬季冰层覆盖北部海盆，而更南方、曼格什拉克半岛以外的海水则逐渐加深。

english: The northeastern Caspian meets the low Buzachi and Mangyshlak peninsulas, where the sea borders a dry land of steppe and desert. Mangyshlak's shores connected the sea with caravan routes across the Ustyurt towards Khiva and Bukhara. In the sixteenth century merchants from Astrakhan visited the coast, while local Turkmen communities knew its waters and shores long before their arrival.
simp_chinese: 里海东北部濒临布扎奇与曼格什拉克半岛的低岸，海水与干燥的草原、沙漠相接。曼格什拉克海岸连接着穿越乌斯秋尔特高原、通往希瓦和布哈拉的商队道路。十六世纪，阿斯特拉罕的商人来到这片海岸；当地土库曼人则在此之前很久便已熟悉这里的海水与海岸。

english: South of the Mangyshlak peninsula, the Caspian opens into its deeper middle basin. The desert shores of the eastern coast contrast with the vast expanse of water beyond them. Ships from Astrakhan traded with Mangyshlak, whose landing places gave access to caravan routes to Khiva and Bukhara. The sea has no outlet to the ocean, and its level has changed over time, reshaping bays and coastal shallows.
simp_chinese: 曼格什拉克半岛以南，里海展开为较深的中部海盆。东岸的荒漠与岸外广阔的水面形成鲜明对照。阿斯特拉罕的船只曾与曼格什拉克贸易，海岸上的登陆点连接通往希瓦和布哈拉的商队路线。里海没有通向大洋的出口，水位历来有所变化，不断重塑海湾与沿岸浅滩。

english: Along the southern Caspian, the narrow coastal plain of Mazandaran lies beneath the forested Alborz mountains. The region was among the provinces that produced raw silk for the Safavid economy. Its shores faced the trading routes north across the sea, but also raids from the eastern Caspian: in the eighteenth century Turkmen seafarers attacked the coasts of Gilan, Mazandaran and Gorgan from their bases across the water.
simp_chinese: 里海南岸狭窄的马赞德兰沿海平原，背靠森林茂密的厄尔布尔士山脉。这里是为萨法维经济提供生丝的地区之一。海岸面向横渡里海北行的贸易航路，同时也受到东部海区的袭击：十八世纪，土库曼航海者从海对岸的据点出发，劫掠吉兰、马赞德兰与戈尔甘海岸。

english: On the eastern shore of the Caspian lies Garabogazköl, a great saline basin joined to the sea by a narrow entrance. Water entering it is exposed to intense evaporation beneath the dry climate of the coastal desert. The shores beyond belong to the country between Mangyshlak and the Balkan coast, where sea routes met long overland journeys across the arid lands of Central Asia.
simp_chinese: 里海东岸有卡拉博加兹戈尔，一座通过狭窄水道与里海相连的巨大咸水盆地。流入的海水在沿岸沙漠的干燥气候下强烈蒸发。附近海岸位于曼格什拉克与巴尔干海岸之间，水路在这里与穿越中亚干旱地带的漫长陆路相接。

english: The eastern Caspian stretches past a long desert shore to the entrance of Garabogazköl. This great, exceptionally salty gulf is separated from the open sea by a narrow strip of land and connected to it by a strait. Farther north, Mangyshlak offered landing places for trade with Central Asia; to the south lay the bays and islands used by Turkmen sailors and fishermen.
simp_chinese: 里海东部沿着漫长的沙漠海岸延伸，靠近卡拉博加兹戈尔的入口。这座盐度极高的大海湾与外海隔着狭长的陆地，由一道水道相连。更北方的曼格什拉克有通往中亚贸易路线的登陆点，南面则是土库曼水手和渔民活动的海湾与岛屿。

english: The eastern Caspian coast is broken by the great bay of Balkan and the projecting Cheleken peninsula. Around these rocky shores Turkmen sailors developed a maritime life distinct from that of the merchants of Astrakhan and Persia. In the eighteenth century the bay, the cape and nearby islands sheltered raiders, who also fished between their expeditions. Inland, the dry country rises towards the Balkan mountains.
simp_chinese: 里海东岸的轮廓为广阔的巴尔干湾和伸入海中的切列肯半岛所打断。在这些多岩石的海岸周围，土库曼水手发展出不同于阿斯特拉罕和波斯商人的海上生活。十八世纪，海湾、海角与附近岛屿为劫掠者提供藏身处，他们在出击间隙也以捕鱼为生。内陆的干燥地带向巴尔干山脉升高。

english: Cheleken projects into the eastern Caspian south of the bay of Balkan. Its long spits extend north and south, the southern one pointing towards the island of Ogurja. The coast and neighbouring islands were among the haunts of Turkmen sailors; in the eighteenth century raiders used them as refuges and lived partly by fishing. Beyond the shore the sea opens westward across the deep southern basin.
simp_chinese: 切列肯半岛从巴尔干湾以南伸入里海东部，狭长的沙嘴向南北延伸，南侧沙嘴指向奥古尔贾岛。这片海岸和附近岛屿是土库曼水手的活动地；十八世纪，劫掠者以此为藏身之处，也靠捕鱼维生。岸外的海面向西展开，通往深邃的里海南部海盆。

english: Ogurja is a long, narrow island off the southeastern shore of the Caspian, south of the Cheleken peninsula. Its dry shores and the nearby coast were part of a world of Turkmen seafarers, fishermen and raiders. In the eighteenth century the island was among the places used as a refuge between attacks on shipping. Southward the coast continues towards the shallow waters of the southeastern Caspian.
simp_chinese: 奥古尔贾是一座狭长的岛屿，位于里海东南岸外、切列肯半岛以南。干燥的岛岸与附近海岸是土库曼航海者、渔民和劫掠者的活动地。十八世纪，这座岛是他们在袭击船只间隙躲避的地点之一。海岸继续向南延伸，通向里海东南角的浅水地带。

english: The southern Caspian forms the deepest part of this enclosed sea, between the wooded mountains of its southern coast and the dry eastern shore. Ships crossing these waters linked the Persian provinces with ports farther north. In the eighteenth century merchants sailed between Astrakhan and Persia, carrying goods that included the silk of Gilan, while Turkmen seafarers frequented the eastern bays and islands.
simp_chinese: 里海南部是这片内陆海最深的部分，位于南岸林木繁茂的山地与干燥的东岸之间。穿越这些水域的船只将波斯诸省与更北方的港口联系起来。十八世纪，商船往来于阿斯特拉罕和波斯之间，运送吉兰丝绸等货物；土库曼航海者则常出没于东部的海湾与岛屿。

english: The open Caspian west of the Balkan coast lies between the sea's middle and southern reaches. To the east the shore is indented by Balkan Bay and marked by the Cheleken peninsula; beyond them stretch the arid lands of Central Asia. Turkmen sailors used the bay and neighbouring islands, fishing as well as raiding shipping. Across the water lay the ports of the western and southern Caspian.
simp_chinese: 巴尔干海岸以西的开阔水域位于里海中部与南部之间。东岸有深入陆地的巴尔干湾和切列肯半岛，岸后延伸着中亚的干旱地带。土库曼水手活跃于海湾和附近岛屿，既捕鱼，也袭击过往船只。海面另一侧则分布着里海西岸与南岸的港口。

english: The middle Caspian lies between the western Caucasian coast and the arid shores south of Mangyshlak. Its waters connect the northern sea, reached through the Volga, with the deeper southern basin. Merchants sailing from Astrakhan used the Caspian to reach Persia and the eastern coast, where landing places linked shipping to the caravan routes across the deserts towards Khiva and Bukhara.
simp_chinese: 里海中部位于西面的高加索海岸与曼格什拉克以南的干旱海岸之间。这里的水域连接伏尔加河通达的北部海区与更深的南部海盆。商人从阿斯特拉罕出发，横渡里海前往波斯和东岸；东岸的登陆点又将航运与穿越沙漠、通向希瓦和布哈拉的商队路线联系起来。

english: West of Mangyshlak, the middle Caspian spreads between the eastern peninsula and the distant Caucasian coast. The peninsula was known in medieval Persian as Siyahkuh, or Black Mountain. Its landing places served routes into Central Asia, and ships from Astrakhan later traded with the bay of Mangyshlak. The sea is enclosed, with no ocean outlet, and its shifting level changes the shape of its low shores.
simp_chinese: 曼格什拉克以西，里海中部在东岸半岛与遥远的高加索海岸之间铺展开来。中世纪波斯人称这座半岛为西亚库赫，意为“黑山”。沿岸登陆点连接中亚内陆的道路，后来阿斯特拉罕的船只也与曼格什拉克湾贸易。里海是一片没有大洋出口的内陆水域，水位涨落会改变低洼海岸的轮廓。

english: The Mangyshlak threshold marks the passage from the shallow northern Caspian into the deeper middle sea. To the east lies the Mangyshlak peninsula, a meeting place of maritime traffic and routes across the deserts of Central Asia. After the Russian conquest of Astrakhan in the sixteenth century, merchants used the northern sea to reach this coast and continue towards the markets of Khiva and Bukhara.
simp_chinese: 曼格什拉克浅坎标志着从浅水的里海北部进入较深的中部海区。东面的曼格什拉克半岛是海上航路与中亚沙漠道路的交汇之地。十六世纪俄国征服阿斯特拉罕之后，商人经北部海区抵达这片海岸，再继续前往希瓦和布哈拉的市场。

english: The southern Caspian washes the green shore between Gilan and Mazandaran, where the Alborz mountains rise behind a narrow coastal plain. These humid provinces supplied much of Persia's raw silk. In the seventeenth century Shah Abbas I sought to control the silk trade, and merchants carried the valuable fibre along routes that included the Caspian crossing to Astrakhan. The deep waters offshore form part of the sea's southern basin.
simp_chinese: 里海南部的海水拍打着吉兰与马赞德兰之间苍翠的海岸，厄尔布尔士山脉耸立在狭窄的沿海平原后方。这些湿润的省份出产波斯的大量生丝。十七世纪，阿巴斯一世试图控制丝绸贸易，商人则沿多条路线运送这一贵重货物，其中包括横渡里海前往阿斯特拉罕的航路。岸外的深水属于里海南部海盆。

english: North of Gilan, the Caspian opens onto the waters that carried merchants between Persia and Astrakhan. Anzali, on the Gilan shore, was known by the late fifteenth century and served as the port of Rasht by the middle of the eighteenth. A bar at the harbour entrance made larger vessels anchor offshore; smaller boats carried people and goods across the lagoon towards Pir Bazar and the road to Rasht.
simp_chinese: 吉兰以北，里海水面开阔，商人沿着这里的航路往来于波斯和阿斯特拉罕之间。吉兰海岸的安扎利在十五世纪末已见于记载，到十八世纪中叶成为拉什特的港口。港口入口处的沙洲迫使较大的船只在外海抛锚，人和货物再由小船运过潟湖，前往皮尔巴扎尔及通向拉什特的道路。

english: The southern Caspian lies north of Gilan's green coastal plain, where the Sefid Rud builds a delta and rivers from the Talesh mountains feed the Anzali lagoon. A sandy coast separates the lagoon from the sea. Ships on these waters connected Persia with ports farther north, carrying goods that included Gilan's silk. The Caspian has no outlet to the ocean, and changes in its level have repeatedly altered its shores.
simp_chinese: 里海南部水域位于吉兰苍翠的沿海平原以北。塞菲德河在岸边形成三角洲，塔雷什山脉的河流则注入安扎利潟湖，沙岸将潟湖与里海隔开。航行于此的船只连接波斯与更北方的港口，货物中包括吉兰丝绸。里海没有通向大洋的出口，水位变化不断改变着海岸。

english: The Absheron peninsula projects from the western shore towards the deep southern Caspian. Beneath the water, a ridge runs eastward from the peninsula towards Cheleken, dividing the middle and southern basins. Islands and shoals lie around Absheron, and farther south the waters open towards the green coasts of Gilan and Mazandaran. The peninsula and its approaches stand on a long-established maritime route linking the Caspian's shores.
simp_chinese: 阿布歇隆半岛从西岸伸出，面向深邃的里海南部海盆。一道水下山脊从半岛向东延伸至切列肯，将中部和南部海盆分开。半岛附近分布着岛屿与浅滩，更南方的海面通向吉兰和马赞德兰苍翠的海岸。半岛及其附近水域位于连接里海各岸的古老航路上。

english: The Absheron peninsula reaches into the Caspian from the western shore, with islands and shoals scattered around its tip. Baku's sheltered bay made it a major port of Shirvan. Oil from the peninsula's wells, together with silk and salt, travelled from Baku to northern Iran, Central Asia and, through Astrakhan, to Russia. A Catalan atlas of 1375 marked the city's importance by calling the Caspian the Sea of Baku.
simp_chinese: 阿布歇隆半岛从里海西岸伸入海中，尖端附近散布着岛屿与浅滩。巴库的避风海湾使它成为希尔凡的重要港口。半岛油井出产的石油连同丝绸、盐，从巴库运往伊朗北部和中亚，也经阿斯特拉罕运往俄罗斯。1375年的一幅加泰罗尼亚地图将里海称为“巴库海”，显示了这座城市的重要地位。

english: North of the Absheron peninsula, the western Caspian coast leads towards Shirvan and Derbent. Ships passing the islands and shoals around the peninsula connected Baku with ports farther north and south. These maritime routes complemented the caravan roads along the Caucasian shore, joining the Volga basin to the markets of Shirvan and Persia. Across the open middle Caspian lay the arid shores of Mangyshlak.
simp_chinese: 阿布歇隆半岛以北，里海西岸向希尔凡与杰尔宾特延伸。船只穿过半岛附近的岛屿与浅滩，连接巴库和南北两方的港口。这些航路与高加索沿岸的商队道路相互补充，将伏尔加河流域与希尔凡、波斯的市场相连。开阔的里海中部对岸，是曼格什拉克的干旱海岸。

english: Casqui was a powerful chiefdom in the lowlands of northeastern Arkansas, where the St. Francis River runs through cypress swamps and rich floodplain. Its fortified principal town stood among smaller settlements ruled by the same chief, and the people grew maize on the river terraces. In 1541 Hernando de Soto arrived while Casqui was at war with the neighbouring chiefdom of Pacaha. Spaniards and Casqui warriors attacked the rival town together. De Soto then brought the two chiefs together and arranged a fragile peace before the expedition moved on. At Casqui the Spaniards raised a cross on the mound where the chief's house stood, an act recorded by members of the expedition.
simp_chinese: 卡斯基是阿肯色东北部低地的强大酋邦，圣弗朗西斯河穿过柏木沼泽与肥沃的洪泛平原。设防的主镇周围分布着同一首领统辖的较小聚落，居民在河边台地上种植玉米。1541年，埃尔南多·德索托抵达时，卡斯基正与邻近的帕卡哈交战。西班牙士兵与卡斯基战士一同攻打了对方的主镇。德索托随后召集两位首领，促成一个脆弱的和平，远征队才继续前行。西班牙人在卡斯基首领住所所在的土丘上竖起十字架，远征队成员记下了这一事件。

english: Cassano stands above the plain of the Crati in northern Calabria, where the mountains descend towards the Ionian Sea. Its bishopric traces its origins to the Byzantine recovery of the valley in the ninth century. The town lay in a region where Greek ecclesiastical traditions met the power of the Norman conquerors, who brought the valley under new rulers in the eleventh century. Its cathedral remained the centre of a diocese serving the surrounding towns and countryside.
simp_chinese: 卡萨诺位于卡拉布里亚北部克拉蒂平原上方，山地在此向爱奥尼亚海下降。主教区的起源可追溯至九世纪拜占庭收复河谷之时。十一世纪诺曼征服者带来新的统治，当地希腊教会传统与其势力在此相遇。大教堂继续作为主教区中心，服务于周围城镇和乡村。

english:
Cassel crowns a prominent hill above the Flemish plain. The Romans developed it as Castellum Menapiorum, the centre of a network of roads converging on the height; later it became a fortified seat of the counts of Flanders and the centre of a castellany encompassing many villages. Its commanding position made the hill a frequent prize in the wars and dynastic disputes of the region.

In 1328 Philip VI of France defeated Flemish rebels led by Nicolaas Zannekin at Cassel. Centuries later, French and Spanish forces repeatedly contested the town. In 1677 a French army defeated the Prince of Orange near Cassel while Saint-Omer was under siege. The Treaty of Nijmegen gave Cassel to France the following year, after which its defences were dismantled.
simp_chinese:
卡塞勒坐落在俯瞰佛兰德平原的高丘之上。罗马人将此地建为梅纳皮人的卡斯特卢姆，通往四方的道路在山顶汇合；后来，它成为佛兰德伯爵的设防据点和一个管辖众多村庄的城堡辖区中心。居高临下的位置使这座山丘屡屡成为地区战争和王朝争端中的争夺目标。

1328年，法国国王腓力六世在卡塞勒击败了尼古拉斯·赞内金领导的佛兰德起义军。数百年后，法国与西班牙军队反复争夺此地。1677年，法军在卡塞勒附近击败奥兰治亲王，当时圣奥梅尔正遭围攻。次年的奈梅亨条约将卡塞勒划归法国，此后城防被拆除。

english: The Cassiar Mountains rise in the northern interior, forming part of a rugged country of forested valleys and headwaters. To their east lie the upper waters of the Liard, within the traditional territory of the Kaska Dena. Kaska families travelled through their extensive homeland according to the seasons, hunting and gathering along rivers and among the mountains. The name Cassiar has been linked to the name Kaska, though other explanations have also been proposed.
simp_chinese: 卡西亚山脉耸立于北方内陆，是森林河谷与众多河流源头所在的崎岖山地的一部分。山脉东面是利亚德河上游，属于卡斯卡德内人的传统地域。卡斯卡家庭随季节穿行于广阔家园，在河流沿岸和群山之中狩猎采集。卡西亚之名被认为与卡斯卡有关，但也有其他解释。

english: The Cassiporé meets the Atlantic on the low coast of Amapá, south of Cape Orange. Tides enter the river mouth and move through a shore of mudflats, mangroves and flooded fields. The coastal waters are influenced by sediment from the Amazon, carried along the northern coast of Brazil. Sand and mud shift with the tides, making the entrances to rivers and coastal channels change over time.
simp_chinese: 卡西波雷河在阿马帕低洼海岸注入大西洋，位于奥兰治角以南。潮水进入河口，穿行于泥滩、红树林和淹水草地之间。沿岸水域受到亚马孙河泥沙的影响，泥沙沿巴西北部海岸移动。沙与泥随潮水迁移，使河口和海岸水道入口不断变化。

english: Castelfranco was founded by Treviso between 1195 and 1199 to guard its frontier against Padua and Vicenza. A moat fed by branches of the Muson surrounded the new castle, and Treviso settled a hundred families of free inhabitants within it. Their exemption from taxes gave the place its name, the free castle. Its walls and towers still define the old town, birthplace of the Renaissance painter Giorgione.
simp_chinese: 卡斯泰尔弗兰科由特雷维索于1195年至1199年间建立，用以守卫与帕多瓦和维琴察接壤的边界。穆松河支流为环绕新城堡的壕沟供水，特雷维索又在城内安置了一百户自由居民。他们享有免税待遇，城镇因此得名“自由城堡”。城墙和塔楼仍勾勒出旧城轮廓，文艺复兴画家乔尔乔内便出生于此。

english: Castellane lies on the Verdon beneath a towering rock once crowned by the citadel of its barons. Louis XI ordered that stronghold destroyed in 1483 after Provence passed to the French crown. The town retained its walls and faced further danger during the Wars of Religion. In 1586 Protestant troops led by the Baron of Allemagne and Lesdiguières attempted to take Castellane, but its defenders repulsed the attack.
simp_chinese: 卡斯泰拉讷坐落在韦尔东河畔，城镇上方耸立的岩峰曾有男爵的城堡。普罗旺斯归入法国王室后，路易十一于1483年下令拆毁堡垒。城镇仍保有城墙，并在宗教战争中再次面临危险。1586年，阿勒马涅男爵与莱迪吉耶尔率领的新教军队试图攻取卡斯泰拉讷，守军击退了进攻。

english:
Kastellaun grew beneath a castle of the counts of Sponheim in the Hunsrück. Count Simon II made it his residence in 1301, granted town rights in 1305 and obtained a market privilege from Emperor Henry VII in 1309. Its position brought the count into conflict with Archbishop Baldwin of Trier, who besieged the town in 1321 and later built Balduinseck Castle nearby to counter it.

When the counts of Sponheim died out in 1437, their lands passed to several heirs who governed Kastellaun jointly. The town suffered occupation and plague during the Thirty Years' War. French troops destroyed the old castle and town during the Nine Years' War. The joint lordship ended in 1776, and after another period of French rule Kastellaun passed to Prussia in 1815.
simp_chinese:
卡斯特劳恩兴起于洪斯吕克地区一座施蓬海姆伯爵城堡下方。伯爵西蒙二世于1301年将此地作为驻地，1305年授予城市权，1309年又从皇帝亨利七世处取得集市特权。城镇的位置使伯爵与特里尔大主教鲍德温发生冲突；后者于1321年围攻此城，后来又在附近修建鲍杜因塞克城堡以牵制它。

1437年施蓬海姆伯爵绝嗣，领地由数位继承人共同治理。三十年战争期间，卡斯特劳恩遭到占领并受到瘟疫侵袭。九年战争中，法军摧毁了城堡和城镇。共同统治于1776年结束；又经历一段法国统治后，卡斯特劳恩于1815年归于普鲁士。

english: Castelló d’Empúries was the capital of the county of Empúries, set inland from the Gulf of Roses amid the marshes of the Empordà. The counts made it their seat after the decline of ancient Empúries. Its great Gothic church of Santa Maria expresses the ambitions of a comital town whose rulers sought an episcopal see of their own, though it remained under the bishop of Girona.
simp_chinese: 安普里亚斯的卡斯特利翁是安普里亚斯伯国的首府，坐落在罗萨斯湾内陆的安普尔达沼泽地带。古代安普里亚斯衰落后，伯爵将治所迁至此地。宏伟的哥特式圣玛丽亚教堂体现了伯爵城镇的雄心：统治者曾希望设立自己的主教座，但城镇仍属于赫罗纳主教管辖。

english: Castellón de la Plana grew on the fertile coastal plain below the hills of eastern Iberia. Its inhabitants originally lived near the old castle of Fadrell; in 1251 James I authorised the settlement to move down to the plain. The new town developed its own walls, churches and civic buildings. Among its landmarks is El Fadrí, a separate bell tower beside the church of Santa María, whose height rises above the streets of the old town.
simp_chinese: 卡斯特利翁德拉普拉纳在伊比利亚东部山丘下肥沃的海岸平原上发展起来。居民原先住在法德雷尔旧城堡附近；1251年，海梅一世批准聚落迁至平原。新城逐渐修建起城墙、教堂和公共建筑。圣玛丽亚教堂旁独立矗立的埃尔法德里钟楼是当地地标，高高耸立在老城街道之上。

sources.title: Historia de Castellón de la Plana

english: Castelnau-de-Médoc takes its name from a castle established in the country between Bordeaux and the Atlantic. The lordship passed through several families, including the Grailly and the Foix-Candale, before being bought in the fifteenth century by the lord of Issan. Around the old castle, the settlement grew among the streams and wooded lands of Médoc, with the church of Saint James serving its parish.
simp_chinese: 梅多克地区卡斯泰尔诺得名于一座城堡，位于波尔多与大西洋之间的乡间。领地先后属于格赖利、富瓦-康达勒等家族，十五世纪由伊桑领主购得。聚落围绕旧城堡发展，四周是梅多克的溪流和林地，圣雅各教堂则服务于当地教区。

english: Castelnaudary lies in the Lauragais, between Toulouse and Carcassonne. The construction of the Canal du Midi gave the town an important harbour on the waterway linking the Atlantic basin with the Mediterranean. Its Grand Bassin was already a stopping place by 1674, while the canal was still being built. Boats could gather in the broad basin below the town before continuing through the locks and along the canal.
simp_chinese: 卡斯泰尔诺达里位于图卢兹与卡尔卡松之间的洛拉盖地区。南运河的修建使城镇在连接大西洋流域与地中海的水道上拥有了一处重要港口。1674年，运河尚在施工，宽阔的大港池便已成为船只停泊之处。船只在城镇下方的水池集结，然后穿过船闸，继续沿运河航行。

english: Castelo Branco grew on the slopes of the hill of Cardosa, beneath a castle associated with the Knights Templar. Land here was donated to the order in 1182, and the settlement received a charter in 1213. The Templars built walls and a castle as the town took shape. Manuel I granted a new charter in 1510, while a Jewish community survived after the forced conversions of the late fifteenth century through families who secretly kept elements of their faith. In 1771 Castelo Branco became a city and a bishop's seat.
simp_chinese: 布朗库堡沿卡尔多萨山坡发展，山上的城堡与圣殿骑士团有关。1182年，此地土地被捐给骑士团，聚落于1213年获得特许状。城镇形成之际，骑士团修建了城墙和城堡。曼努埃尔一世于1510年颁发新特许状；十五世纪末强制改宗之后，一些犹太家庭仍秘密保留信仰的部分传统。1771年，布朗库堡升为城市并成为主教驻地。

english: Castelsardo rises above the eastern end of the Gulf of Asinara on Sardinia's northern coast. The town grew around a castle built by the Genoese Doria family, who held it as Castel Doria or Castelgenovese. In 1448 the Aragonese conquered the stronghold and renamed it Castel Aragonese. Its steep site and walls preserved the memory of a long contest for control of the island's northern shore.
simp_chinese: 卡斯特尔萨多坐落在撒丁岛北岸，俯瞰阿西纳拉湾东端。城镇围绕热那亚多里亚家族建造的城堡发展，当时称为多里亚城堡或热那亚城堡。1448年，阿拉贡人征服据点，将其改名为阿拉贡城堡。陡峭地势与城墙见证了为控制岛屿北岸而进行的长期争斗。

english:
Castlebar grew around a castle in the heart of Mayo, east of Clew Bay. It became a market town serving the surrounding countryside and received a charter of incorporation from James I in 1613. Its name would become famous in the upheaval of 1798, when a small French expedition landed on the Mayo coast to support the Irish rebellion against British rule.

General Jean Humbert marched inland with his French troops and Irish allies. On 27 August they attacked the Crown forces defending Castlebar and drove them from the town. The speed of the retreat gave the encounter its enduring nickname, the “Races of Castlebar”. The victory encouraged more local men to join Humbert, although the expedition was ultimately defeated elsewhere in Ireland.
simp_chinese:
卡斯尔巴在梅奥腹地的一座城堡周围发展起来，位于克鲁湾以东。它成为服务周边乡村的市镇，并于1613年获得詹姆斯一世的自治特许状。1798年的动荡使这里声名远扬：一支法国远征军在梅奥海岸登陆，援助反抗英国统治的爱尔兰起义。

让·安贝尔将军率法国部队及爱尔兰盟友向内陆进军。8月27日，他们进攻守卫卡斯尔巴的王室军队，将其逐出城镇。守军撤退之快，使这场战斗得到了“卡斯尔巴赛跑”的绰号。胜利促使更多当地人加入安贝尔的队伍，但远征军最终在爱尔兰其他地方被击败。

english: Castleconnell stands beside the Shannon northeast of Limerick, where the river flows between Lough Derg and the city. Its name recalls the castle of the O'Conaings, an old stronghold above the water. A medieval castle was built here as Anglo-Norman power spread through the region, and the settlement grew near the river and its crossing. In the Williamite war the castle was damaged during the fighting around Limerick; its broken remains overlook a stretch of the Shannon that has long shaped the life of the village.
simp_chinese: 卡斯尔康奈尔位于利默里克东北的香农河畔，河水从德格湖流向城市，经过此地。地名让人想起奥科宁家族的城堡，这是一座俯瞰河流的古老据点。随着盎格鲁—诺曼势力进入该地区，一座中世纪城堡在此建成，聚落也在河流与渡口附近发展。威廉派战争中，城堡在利默里克周围的战斗中受损，残存墙垣俯瞰着长期影响村庄生活的香农河。

english: Castlerea takes its name from Caisleán Riabhach, a castle of the O'Conors that stood where the Cloonard meets the River Suck. A settlement grew around this stronghold in the countryside of western Roscommon. In the seventeenth century Theophilus Sandford acquired extensive lands here that had been taken from the O'Conors, a change linked to his service in the civil wars in England. The Sandford residence was built on the site of the old castle, and buildings of the town developed around the estate.
simp_chinese: 卡斯尔雷得名于奥康纳家族的卡斯兰里亚瓦赫城堡，城堡曾坐落在克卢纳德河与萨克河交汇处。罗斯康芒西部乡间的聚落围绕这处据点发展起来。十七世纪，西奥菲勒斯·桑德福德因在英国内战中的服务，获得了从奥康纳家族手中夺取的大片当地土地。桑德福德家族的宅邸建在旧城堡遗址上，城镇建筑也在庄园周围发展。

english:
Castres lies in the old province of Languedoc in southern France, east of Toulouse and near the wooded foothills of the Massif Central. The Agout and Durenque rivers cross this inland site, providing power and water while leaving the town somewhat removed from the main east-west corridors. Its name comes from Latin castrum, “fortified place”. The settlement grew around the Benedictine abbey of Saint Benoît, believed founded in AD 647, perhaps on the site of an older Roman fort.

By about 1560, most of the population had converted to Protestantism. During the later religious wars, residents fortified Castres, supported the Protestant party and established an independent republic. It became one of southern France’s largest Protestant strongholds, alongside Montauban and La Rochelle. Henry of Navarre stayed there in 1585. Louis XIII brought the town to terms in 1629, and Richelieu personally came to have its fortifications dismantled.

Peace allowed commercial recovery, especially in wool, tanning and fur. Mechanized textile mills arrived in the nineteenth century, the first wool mill being set up in 1815. Castres was the largest town in the Tarn department, and Albi later surpassed it. The riverside town’s history therefore moves from abbey and religious conflict to manufacturing and rivalry within Languedoc.
simp_chinese:
卡斯特尔位于法国南部旧朗格多克省，在图卢兹以东，靠近中央高原林木覆盖的丘陵。阿古河与迪朗克河流经这处内陆城镇，既提供水力与用水，又使它略离开东西向的主要通道。名称源于拉丁语“城堡”或“设防地”。聚落围绕圣伯努瓦本笃会修道院成长；修道院据信建于公元647年，可能坐落在更早的罗马堡垒旧址上。

约1560年，大部分居民改宗新教。在此后的宗教战争中，居民加固城防、支持新教阵营，并建立独立共和国，使卡斯特尔与蒙托邦、拉罗谢尔并列为法国南部重要的新教据点。纳瓦拉的亨利曾于1585年驻留于此。1629年，路易十三迫使城镇屈服，黎塞留还亲自前来拆除防御工事。

和平带来商业复苏，毛纺、制革和毛皮业重新活跃。十九世纪引入机械化毛纺厂，1815年城内建起第一座机械化毛纺厂。卡斯特尔曾是塔恩省人口最多的城镇，阿尔比后来超过了它。这座河畔城市的历史因此从修道院与宗教冲突，延伸到制造业和朗格多克内部的城市竞争。
